title: Waste Treatment Plant

details.full_description:
profile the innovator is from the kottayam district of kerala. purpose the innovator manages three houses for mentally challenged people who do not have any hopes and dreams and few without a home too. it is but with the generous help of the well-wishers he could meet the ends of daily needs.  he needed an all-time solution for this, with constraints like daily waste from the kitchen, daily waste from the latrine, limited area,  financial situations etc. mind these constraints he implemented a cost-effective construction for waste. technical details innovator has designed and implemented a highly functional waste treatment plant. in this system, the direct connection is given from the bathroom to the plant. a jar of 20,000 cc capacity is connected from pvc pipes of the closet, approximately 3 feet nearer to the plant. the main plant is attached together with the 3 concrete pipes. at the outlet of the concrete plant, a collection tank is built. the plastic jar has an opening through which other waste materials from the kitchen or any other decomposable waste can be deposited. two openings were made at the top portion of each concrete pipe as per the requirement. the gas collected from this plant is used in the kitchen for three hours continuously a day. benefits this system produces two by-products and they are treated water and waste, the treated water is used to irrigate grass cultivation. suggested reading(s): eger, l. o., & crosby, s. c. (1976). sanitary waste treatment plant . u.s. patent no. 3,950,249 . washington, dc: u.s. patent and trademark office. furuichi, t., kannan, k., suzuki, k., tanaka,

title: Advanced Drinking Water Technology in Diary Farming

details.full_description: profile mr. divakaran nambiar is from kasaragod district of kerala. the innovator is a dairy farmer. purpose the innovator has developed a cost-effective technology for providing drinking water to dairy animals with minimal human intervention. technical specifications the developed technology is having a pit in front of the animals made with terracotta or cement flower pots are interconnected through an elevated channel which in turn is connected to a master tank near the cattle shed, so that the water level in the master tank is maintained in all the pits. this level is maintained in such a way that the animals can easily drink water from the pit. the master tank is connected to an overhead tank and with the help of a flush valve constant water level is maintained in the master tank. when the animals drink water from the pit, it lowers the level of water in the master tank and this will open the flush valve to maintain the water head. benefits this system makes it confirm that water for the animal is available all time, doesn't matter whether the caretaker is there or not and also makes it easy for the caretaker to take care of all the cattle. suggested reading(s): deere and company,(2021). how to build a self-filling livestock water tank. retrieved on september 14, 2021, from https://tipsnotebook.deere.com/build-self-filling-livestock-water-tank/ youtube, (2018). how to build a self-filling livestock water tank. retrieved on september 14, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vuajoxagzdu

title: Ground Water Recharging Unit

details.full_description:
profile the innovator, mr. rajakannu r is from puduchcheri, india. he studied till xi standard and have quite good knowledge of groundwater and irrigation system. one day in 2004, he was travelling by train from chidambaram to pattukottai. though it was summer, the land experienced a torrential downpour and he saw floodwaters everywhere on his way. the cultivable lands were submerged by floodwater without fructifying anything on the land. he was pained by this incident and this led him to think about the water problems menacing our country. purpose the innovator has suggested the idea that if rainwater is collected in huge quantities under the earth, the groundwater so stored would not be affected by evaporation or by seepage as is found in ponds, lakes, and tanks. technical details according to him, he has drawn up a structural device known as a groundwater recharging unit (g r unit). the g r unit consists of a pvc borewell of 2 feet diameter having a length of 100-150 feet and a concrete structure. the g r unit will absorb the flood water by the earth's gravitational force and do not require any extra power source. benefit this unit will help to recharge the groundwater and can help to solve the water crisis. suggested reading(s): döll, p., & fiedler, k. (2008).

title: New cultivation method for rubber crop

details.full_description: profile: innovator manuel is a farmer, studied upto degree ( not completed). leaned electronics and homeopathy by experience and with own efforts and part of his income comes from repairing electronics equipments installing antennae etc. purpose: to find a new cultivation method for for cultivating rubber in an efficient manner. technical details: he has developed an interesting way of cultivating rubber. he has planted two trees in single pit maintaining a spacing of 20 feet between two plants and 18 feet with next row of plants, with a total of 300 plants in one acre against 170 plants in conventional method. the logic according to him is that every plant has attractive and repulsive magnetic field strength. we need to plant trees in such a way to minimize the repulsion and maximize the benefit of attraction. with this innovative spacing, a set of plants in the first row will come in the middle of set of plants in the second row, maintaining a distance of 36 feet in straight line and 20 feet angle with second row. benefits: hence it will allow the branches to grow in south and north direction according to the magnetic field of earth. by using this innovative way the yield per plant is same as in conventional planting, but the yield per acre is almost double than the conventional farming. suggested readings: youtube, (2019). how to rubber tapping in scientific method.  retrieved on february, 11th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r-c2_gu_mkk youtube, (2018). amazing asia natural rubber farm - rubber harvesting and processing. retrieved on february, 11th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z5bjx1yyir0

title: Multipurpose Dryer

details.full_description: profile: the innovator is from ernakulam district of kerala. purpose: the innovator used to experiment new devices and techniques available in the market. in 2008-09, the innovator comes across a new dryer in an agriculture periodical name krshakan. while using it, he noticed that heat supply was not as promised. this made him thinking about modifying the device. initial 2 - 3 months were spent only for planting. it was difficult for him to get a mason who can work as per his instructions. technical details: he used his old coconut mill and inserted a wall to the structure and did some assembling work with gi sheet. as he says, majorly the innovation lies with the examination of new pipe developed out of gi sheet. as a result, more heat supply and fire came. in the entrance, there is a small burner where wood for burning has to be placed. at the opening of the burner, wood can be supplied and in the place where opening ends, there is a trim made out of the iron cylinder. beside this hole, air passes inside and there is pipe lying on the outer wall in the same line of the burner. this pipe is having a length about 7 feet. in the bottom of the pipe, there is a cement layer having a width about 5 inches and a height about one foot. the bottom and the side of this cement layer is given the gi sheet covering. in the inside where the burner ends, there is an iron cylinder connected. the top of the cylinder is closed with gi sheet and from the hole provided on the top, a pipe is fixed, which is made out of asbestos. there is a concrete joint of l shape made out of cement bricks at the end of this pipe and on the side, there is a wooden layer where small pieces can be dried. the concrete is of 4 feet height and on the other side of concrete also, there is a pipe and this asbestos pipe is connected to the outside wall where the lengthy pipe is there. these pipes which are of similar length facilitate the passage of air/ emissions outside. greater the height, greater the fire and more emissions come.  thus this dryer has two chambers. the g.i chamber can be used for drying large quantities of goods and the wooden chamber can be used for small quantity. the net layer on the top is connected to the wall and appears like a box inside the wall. benefits: with the help of this dryer using about 200 kg wood, we can dry about 300 kg coco and it can be used in some applications also. suggested reading(s): ayensu, a. title: A low cost mechanical model for generating electricity from waves

details.full_description: profile: the innovator is from kottayam district of kerala. purpose: to develop a low-cost mechanical model for generating electricity from waves to find the new source of electricity generation. technical details: the innovator has presented a mechanical model for generating electricity from sea waves. this device is divided into two parts i) one is on the seashore (turbine, propeller shaft and freewheel) ii) another is submerged in the sea (big metal frame, airbags, pulleys, stings, counterweight). a big rectangle frame submerged below the sea level (10 m - 15 m). both end of this rectangle frame installed with a movable position (up or down) at the seashore. air bags are attached below the rectangle frame. due to the presence of these airbags, the rectangular frame goes upward, but with a counterweight, it is locked to go upward. as a result, this frame is kept constantly at a particular level in the sea. the supporting airbags are below sea level. so the waves cannot influence the frame or airbags. the turbine is connected to the primary propeller shaft. primary propeller shaft connected to secondary propeller shaft. many freewheels ( one side rotation) are connected with these secondary propeller shafts. the rotation of one freewheel doesn't affect another. the turbine is connected to primary shafts are made with many freewheels. pulleys are installed in the frame. strings are passed through these pulleys. one end of these strings is connected with another type of airbags which are above the sea level. another end of the strings is connected to the freewheels. according to the waves of the sea, the airbags which are floated on the sea, start moving i.e. up and down motion. according to the movement of this floating airbags, the freewheels start rotating with the help of the string connecting between them. when the freewheel rotating the propeller shaft is also rotating. the turbine is connected to this propeller shaft. thus the electricity is produced. benefits: nowadays in developing countries like india to develop the industrialization we need a variety of power generation sources since we cannot rely on a single source of energy especially the source which uses fossil fuel to generate electricity so to be independent in field of power generation this type of technologies is required. suggested reading(s): nwaokocha, c. n., & layeni, a. t. (2013). ocean wave energy an option for nigerian power situation. scientific research and essays, 8 (32), 1547-1552. youtube, (2016). wave energy plants in brazil english subtitles. retrieved on december 31, 2020, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qznzg3z4fc \ youtube, (2020). best science project ocean power plant generates energy from waves best project   retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uzgmre1z2eq

title: Low-cost eco-friendly mosquito destroyer

details.full_description: profile the innovator is from kozhikode (calicut) of kerala. purpose as we know that nowadays mosquitoes are the vector of many diseases hence we have to use some chemicals to get rid of them hence innovators developed a low-cost eco-friendly mosquito destroyer. t echnical details the innovator has developed a low-cost mosquito attractor com destroyer. the unit consists of a rectangular glass box with a base dimension of 1-foot x 8 inches. this box is divided into two equal compartments by a glass piece, running from top to 4 - 5 inches above the bottom. one of these chambers is covered at the top using glass. in the other compartment, a plastic net ( through which mosquito larvae cannot escape) is fixed few inches beneath the top. water is filled up to the level of the net. to attract mosquito salt and sugar is added to water in the same proportion as that of ors solution. the smell of the solution attracts the mosquitoes and they lay eggs by sitting on the plastic net. the eggs fall to the water through the net but the mature larvae cannot escape through the net and they will try to escape by entering the chamber covered with glass. as mosquitoes cannot escape they will die after 2 - 3 days. the innovator claims that two such tanks are sufficient to control mosquitoes in a household to a great extent. benefits hence this device does not include harmful chemicals so there are no harmful effects on humans hence eco-friendly and affordable suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). ultratail™ eco-friendly electronic led mosquito killer machine trap lamp,usb powered electronic fly inhaler mosquito killer lamp,mosquito killer,mosquito killer lamp,mosquito killer lamp for home. retrieved on august 16, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/ultratailtm-friendly-electronic-mosquito-machine/dp/b08262gpfw indiamart, (2021). generic eco-friendly mosquito killer lamp. retrieved on august 16, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/mosquito-killer-lamp-23101459355.html

title: Rubber tapping shade with aluminum sheet

details.full_description: profile: the innovator is a farmer and rubber tapper. purpose: to make a rubber tapping shade technical specifications: he has developed an aluminum sheet based rubber tapping shade ( substitute for commonly used plastic shades), which he has been using successfully. the design is simple and can be fabricated easily by the farmer without any technical help. using 1 kg aluminum sheet, three such shades can be fabricated. benefits: innovator claims that the disadvantage of falling of the plastic sheet shade into milk collecting cup during rain and windy conditions can be completely avoided and this is long lasting.

title: Power tiller operated turmeric harvester

details.full_description: innovator ramaraju has been involved in farming since childhood. he faced acute labour shortage while harvesting turmeric rhizomes. delay in harvesting resulted in loss of yield and adversely affected the quality of rhizomes. in 2008, he consulted tamil nadu agriculture university ( tnau), coimbatore for solving this problem and studied a machine developed by the university . the same year, he made an attachment for a power tiller to harvest turmeric based on the design of the machine at tnau. however, it damaged over 50 % rhizomes during trials. he started modifying the machine and 2009, developed a second prototype worth over 75 percent efficiency. he continued with improvements and 2001, developed the final prototype with over 95 percent efficiency. the prototype were made using a private lathe at ' mani automobiles' in the town of koundapadi near erode. the innovator has an informal agreement with this same unit for manufacturing and selling the harvester attachment and giving him a royalty. this is a power tiller operated turmeric harvester. it is mounted at the rear of the power tiller and takes drive from its power take-off (pto) through a belt and pulley. it has a blade with three bar points for easy penetration into the soil, connected with eight slats of mild steel which gets oscillating motion from the power tiller through eccentrics. this oscillating motion separates the turmeric rhizomes from soil without damage, the current price of attachment is rs. 26000/-. it has a field capacity of about 0.2 acre per hour while consuming 1.5 liter of fuel ( diesel).  more than 200 units have been sold by the innovator. weight of the attachment is 50 kg. while using this machine one needs to engage two persons for driving the power tiller alternatively and about  35 persons for collecting the harvested rhizomes per day, if the same is done manually.

title: Paddy marking tool for SRI method

details.full_description: profile: the innovator is from palakkad(palghat) district of kerala. he is an agriculturist and paddy is the main crop he cultivates. purpose: the innovator has developed a paddy marking too to ease in paddy plantation. technical details: according to the innovator, he has developed a marking tool for maintaining accuracy in rice planting in sri method of rice cultivation. in the normal methods followed the planting the plant to plant and row to row spacing cannot be obtained accurately. the developed tool comprises of two iron pole with the adjustable leg of 23 cm x 30 cm. these poles are connected by a plastic rope, which is marked at an interval of 23 cm by bicycle tube pieces. benefits: the innovator has been using the tool and claims that saving in time and high accuracy in cultivation is obtained. suggested reading(s): murumkar, r. p., dongarwar, u. r., phad, d. s., borkar, b. y., & pisalkar, p. s. title: Arecanut husking tool

details.full_description: purpose: usually poor farmers use knife for husking areca nuts, which involve risk of accidents and is time consuming. observing this problem, innovator yesudas thought of developing an affordable alternative. he started working on it in 2002. with some ideas for design of hand-operated tools, he approached local fabricator. technical specifications: he developed a few prototypes and kept improving them through trials for three years. the first successful prototype was developed in 2005. it has two v-shaped pointed blades. on pressing the handle, the blades remove husk from the arecanut. when the handle is released, the blades come back to their original position due to spring mechanism. only one nut can be  husked at a time. benefits: the areca nuts can be husked even while holding the machine in hands it can husk 7.5 kg (200 - 220 nuts per hour. i weighs 180 gm. it costs rs. 250. the innovator has sold over 5000 units.

title: An automatic head beeping device for vehicles

details.full_description: profile the innovator hails from jagannathpur village of puri district. he has innovated a device called " automatic head beeper switch for 4-wheelers as well as for a motorcycle. purpose innovator has suggested the mechanism which can enhance the road safety. technical details when we drive in a vehicle or in a motorcycle, other vehicles overtake us from the backside or also pass by us from the front side. sometimes speedy vehicles come either from the front or from back or from different directions for which due to little bit absent-mindedness accident occurs. to make a driver sense speedy vehicle, the innovator has developed a device by which a driver can sense another vehicle at 50 meters behind or front side. the driver can know it in terms of the beep sound that comes in the vehicle. it works well in fog and in rain. the device works wonderfully and is very cheap. benefits it can help to reduce the accidents which occurs due to human error. suggested readings: youtube, (2014). mercedes-benz accident avoidance -- collision prevention assist plus. retrieved on march, 15th  2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u80erax8ijq youtube, (2017). how to make arduino based collision detection warning system. retrieved on march, 15th  2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqzqhcpm00s

title: Tractor Mounted Reaper

details.full_description: profile the innovator is from the sabar kantha district of gujarat. purpose the innovator modified the reaper that is used to harvest the crop at ground level. technical details the reaper consists of mainly reciprocating cutter bar, star wheel, conveyor belt and v-belt for power transmission.  in a modified reaper, the power transmission belt is replaced by chain and sprocket so that there is no slippage and power loss is minimum. an additional conveyor belt is provided in the reaper for easy conveyance and no blockage of high growing crops like sorghum. hence, the cop is easily guided by the star wheels to cutter bar and held in the vertical position by the springs and the crop is easily conveyed to the side by conveyor belt. benefits loss of power is minimum, no slippage, suggested reading(s): devnani, r. s., & pandey, m. m. title: Mobile Groundnut Thresher Cum Collector

details.full_description: profile the innovator is from the surendranagar district of gujarat. he studied till vi standard and he started farming at an early age of 11 years. he faced scarcity of labour at the time of harvesting the groundnut. large manpower is needed to collect the harvested/ dug groundnut crop at one location. after digging, the harvested crop is left to dry in the field. delay in the collection of the dried crop results in loss of yield. to overcome these problems, he always uses to think of the innovative machines that can reduce human effort and increase productivity but for many years he did not have sufficient funds to implement on his ideas. he started working towards the development of this machine in 2007 and the first model was developed in 2010. it was further modified in 2012 purpose the innovator has developed a groundnut thresher that collects the stalk and groundnut in the separate chamber. technical details the machine is tractor-mounted, pto powered (50 hp tractor), mobile thresher. the length, width and height of the machine is 7 m, 2 m and 2 m, respectively and it consists of four chambers: lifting and cutting chamber, sieving and blower chamber, groundnut storage chamber and chaff storage chamber. it consists of a chute feed, threshing cylinder, aspirator, pod storage tank and haulm storage tank and all are mounted on a frame. the power is transmitted through the v-belt and pulleys with necessary shields. aspirator having 4-blades is provided with sufficient airflow for proper cleaning. the crop is harvested and dried in the field for a week. then the dried crop is fed to the inlet. the lifting mechanism guides the harvested crop to the cutter where the crop is threshed. the cutter detaches the groundnut from the stalk, after which they fall over the sieve and are separated. the groundnut is collected at the bottom of the sieve and is transferred to the groundnut collecting chamber through the conveyor system. the stalk is separated with the help of the blower and collected in a separate chamber. there is a hydraulic mechanism provided for the ease of unloading of chaff and a cup feed conveyor system is provided for the unloading of groundnut pods from the groundnut storage chamber. performance the innovator has claimed that the machine has a capacity of 6.23 cubic meters for groundnut storage and 12.56 cubic meter for chaff storage. it has a field capacity of 0.3 ha/h ( approximately 0.5 tons of crop). the fuel consumption of the machine is 3.5 liter/hr. benefits it reduces the manpower required to perform the operation as compared to the conventional machines. suggested reading(s): amrutiya, m. d., makavana, j. m., kachhot, a. r., chauhan, p. m., & tiwari, v. k. details.full_description: profile innovator mr ibrahim & karim is from orisssa. purpose innovator has suggested the method that can load the tractor easily. technical details according to the innovator, the main function of blower is that it helps in the loading of trolleys with chara for cows and farm animals. it requires lot of manpower, but with the help of this innovation the double decker trolley is fully loaded in just 40 minutes and requires man power, just concern of one person to start the engine of tractor. benefits it reduces time and labour cost. suggested reading(s): youtube, (2020). straw blower retrieved on 16 august 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qe7oevgkjry youtube, (2020).  tractor mounted straw blower.  retrieved on 16 august 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zl6vpeff1qu

title: Honey Extraction Tool

details.full_description: profile innovator, mr. mahesh hegde hails from uttara kannada district of karnataka. he is a commerce graduate who is looking after farming joined with his father. apart from agriculture, the innovator is doing bee culture in is home. purpose mr. mahesh hegde found difficulties in honey extraction from the comb and he observed more wastage in this process using the manual method of squeezing. one day he observed a butter-churning machine where the churning takes place due to the centrifugal force. hence, he thought of developing a small system to extract the honey from the comb frame. technical details the unit consists of a rectangular frame made with 25 gauge wire mesh with a size of 10 inch x 45 inch (h x w) of width and provided with top open end with 2.5 inches clearance. a 6 mm ms rod of 1-foot length is hinged inside the frame to hold the frame in the churning machine. the rectangular honey hive (10 inch x 3 inch) is kept inside the wire mesh frame. the whole set is fitted to the hand-operated butter churning machine. a bucket or vessel is kept and covered the frame to collect the honey. the handle is rotated and the drive shaft obtained about 60-70 rpm through gear arrangement in levering thus created the centrifugal force to extract the honey. the honey splashes out from the comb due to the centrifugal force and collected in the bucket. the completed frames removed and the new one will be placed. performance according to mr. mahesh, a single person can do about 70-80 frames per hour with this tool. benefits it makes honey extraction easy and effective. suggested readings: youtube, (2017). beekeeping - using the diy honey extractor. retrieved on february, 12th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xnmsiuuzs7g youtube, (2017). honey harvest - spinning out 4 gallons of honey! retrieved on february, 12th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jgxuq6ahfka

title: Peeling machine for nuts and fruits especially for Areca nut and Tung

details.full_description: arecanut and tung (aleurites montana) are two important cash crops of mizoram. however, one of the main problem being faced by plantation owners and farmers is that the peeling of such nuts is very tedious and high labour cost makes it sometimes uneconomical for them to gain from their crops. looking at the problem, the innovator came up with two portable designs for the peeling of such nuts and had even experimented with rough prototypes. one of the designs work on the principle of crushing the nuts and separating the husk from inner core by air pressure. the other design works on the principle of scrapping the husk covering on a rotating drum with blades on the side of the rotating drum. the machines are easy to operate and useful to generate employment in the rural area.

title: Drip pipe slitting unit

details.full_description: innovation details drip laterals do not have a long life due to the continuous exposure of sunlight on laterals. once they are damaged farmers have an option that sells them as scrap for recycling. hence they get very low money. innovator, mr. vivel hegade has found a solution on it, developed a machine which can be used to split the round pipes into four or six segments as required. this can be used as raw material for weaving mats, bags etc. thus the machine has increased utility of damaged pipes at the local level. this machine is operated manually as well as on power.

title: Machine for crushing leaves to make manure

details.full_description: profile innovator mr mruthunjayappa is from orissa. purpose in his garden there is more wastage of trees leaves that fall on the ground. it is very expensive for him to clean the wastage because of extensive labour charges and transportation cost like tractor. innovator conceived the idea of machine that could make manure out of leaves and other raw material. he searched for the available for the purpose but could not get suitable machine. the he himself made a machine. the leaves of trees like coconut leaves, arecanut leaves, gliceridia, lantana etc are placed in the machine. technical details according to the innovator, the machine is powered by 5 hp engine. it crutches a load of tractor of coconut leaves, arecanut leaves, gliceridea and the sticks of lantana within an hour. the crushed material is used as a compost manure. benefits the machine is eco-friendly suggested reading(s): manuwa, s. i., sedara, a. m., & tola, f. a. title: Multi-angle power weeder

details.full_description: profile innovator mr natarajan is from orissa. technical details according to the innovator, while developing the petrol engine operated weeder, innovator used to study research articles on configuration of blades. he developed prototype and experimented with different configurations of blades to observe change in the direction of throw of soil and its effects on plants. while doing experiments, he finalized the design of multi-angle weeder suitable for crops at different age. it is a self propelled diesel engine operated weeder having l-shaped blades arranged in spiral configuration. the arm holding the tool is adjustable and retractable to enable the weeder to move between the plants. angle of shaft holding the tool can be changed for changing direction of throw n the desired direction according to the age of plants . the machine can cover 0.22 - 0.25 ha/h with fuel consumption of one litre per hour. suggested readings: hegazy, r. a., abdelmotaleb, i. a., imara, z. m., & okasha, m. h. title: Manual bottle filling machine

details.full_description: profile innovator mr ahmed is from orrisa. purpose for his toilet cleaning manufacturing plant, innovator  late motin ahmad needed a bottle filling machine. the machines available in market were very costly and required electricity supply. motin ahmad decided to develop his own machine. his machine runs without electricity and is much lower than those commonly available in the market. technical details according to the innovator, the liquid to be put in the bottle is kept in the head tank. the lower side of the head tank has nine pipes. from these pipes, the liquid falls into the measuring jar. the size of the measuring jar varies with the quantity of liquid to be filled. from the jar, the liquid falls in the bottles kept on the conveyor belt. as a batch of bottles fills up, the conveyor belt moves to put another batch in proper position. benefits it is eco-friendly. suggested readings: sigmatecheng, (2019). manual bottle filling machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021, from https://www.sigmatecheng.com/shop/product/bottle-filling-machine/?gclid=cj0kcqiapsibbhckarisan8o_4gv... youtube, (2019). manual liquid filling machine, juice glass filling machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4lcctbwujk

title: Water turbine

details.full_description: profile innovator mr rajalingiah is from orissa. purpose innovator has developed a water turbine irrigation for small  farmers. this device is a sustainable form of irrigation for small farmers with no recurring costs. it pumps the flowing water from the canal (lower level)  next to the field using the water of canal itself to run the pump. technical details according to the innovator, depending on the gradient of the canal, a small quantity of water is tapped upstream and brought down for almost 200 meters and made to flow on to turbine fitted at ground level. the head and the kinetic energy of the water rotate the turbine. turbine is coupled through a shaft to the pump of suitable size, which lifts the water from the canal and pumps it to the fields, providing water for irrigation. the size of the turbine depends upon the pump capacity. pump capacity is linked to the minimum water level in the canal during the year, the distance to which the water is to be pumped and the lift required. applications for such devices could be many including low cost power generation, use the power available for any agricultural works in the field, preparing animal green feed etc. benefits it is ecofriendly. suggested reading(s): prasad, v., swami, m., tambe, v., kamate, f., & bagade, s. (2016). wind operated water pump. international research journal of engineering and technology 3 (5) 1433-1437. youtube, (2016). diy small windmill water pump. retrieved on december 30, 2020, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7dfcykcvtfk

title: Huma Toilet Cleaner

details.full_description: profile mr. md motin ahmed is from the state of orissa. a toilet cleaning manufacturing plant is owned by an him. purpose mr. md motin ahmed has come up with a chemical that cleans the toilet germs. technical details he developed a toilet cleaner known as the huma toilet cleaner. this cleaner is a new addition to the chemical family that combines all of the benefits of cleaning a dirty surface with the extra bonus of having no detrimental effect on the toilet's enamel. benefits it also provides protection to children. the huma toilet cleaner's main features are that it completely eliminates germs, cleans with shine, repels insects, and has a pleasant perfume. suggested reading(s): indiamart, (2021). housekeeping chemicals. retrieved on 15 june, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/vidyasagarstationery/housekeeping-chemicals.html cleaningshop, (2021). toilet cleaner - commercial grade disinfectant. retrieved on 15 june, 2021, from https://www.cleaningshop.com.au/contents/en-us/p3443.html

title: Turbinator

details.full_description: man has developed so many devices, machines and gadgets to make life easier, but most needs external energy to power them. idea of turbine-generator was conceived by innovator in year 2005 and made a model prototype of hydro powered device ( hrdo-gen) for lifting water from lower level to a higher level. innovator was awarded consolation prize in 2006 from nif. this innovation was for the rural farmers in the plans where water flows in the farm irrigation channel flow at lower level than the fields. since then the innovator has conceived several improved types of innovation  and turbinator is one of them. the innovation relates to hydro-electric generation and harnessing potential energy of slow moving water mass to pump water to a higher level. the turbinator consists of a spiral hydrofoil over a conical head and is connected to the electric generator/water pump via a geared shaft where motion is transferred. the hydrofoil works on the principal of turbine dynamics, where flowing water hits the foil. it causes the spiral to shift on its axis continuously as long as the flow is present. the turbinator are smart generators which generate 0.5 to 1 kva of electricity and pump 10 to 15 ltrs of water per minute.  the prototype has been developed and tested successfully and is feasible for mass production to meet the gap of electricity generation and supply in the hilly and unreachable areas.

title: Fish dryer

details.full_description: sun-drying of fish is traditionally practiced in manipur. it is not only time-consuming, but the fish also need protection from other animals while drying. the innovator has developed a dryer that uniformly dries fish in a significantly lower time the traditional method. this closed vessel type structure of the dryer also protects the fish from animals. many customers prefer a light brown colour in dried fish. use of paddy husk as fuel imparts this colour to the fish. the innovator has developed the fish dryer in three sizes. i). small size fish dryer: the dimensions are 3.5 cm x 24.4 cm x 41 cm. it uses charcoal and paddy husk for fuel. it has greater demand than the bigger sized dryers. it is made using an oil container of 15 litre capacity. ii) medium sized fish dryer: it is made of aluminum sheets. it has a detachable fuel chamber. again, charcoal and paddy husk is used as fuel.iii) large sized fish dryer: the dimensions are 65cm x 40cm x 60cm. it is also made of aluminum sheets and uses charcoal and paddy husk as fuel. i both medium and large sized dryers, fish gets burned in the middle section of the tray due to greater thermal convection in that area.

title: Foot and palm guard for climbing coconut trees

details.full_description: idea and purpose the innovator a coconut farmer and coconut tree climber noticed ulcers that developed by constant rubbing while climbing a coconut tree. he came up with a solution and has developed a gloves type of aid to protect the coconut tree climbers from  developing corns on the toes and hands. innovator states that by wearing this leather device that he developed, fully prevented him from  formation of ulcers and other bruises. suggested readings: amazon, (2021). xtrim cobra shaped leather grip padded non-slip palm protector-integrated wide neoprene wrist wrap support cross-fit weightlifting perfect for pull ups dead lifts strong grips more reps. retrieved on february, 15th 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/non-slip-protector-integrated-neoprene-cross-fit-weightlifting/dp/b083wkkqtw/r... youtube, (2020). 10 best climbing gloves 2020  retrieved on february, 15th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eg308etsros

title: Modified knapsack sprayer

details.full_description: innovator observed that existing sprayers are difficult to operate due to fast fatigue, poor work rate associated with nozzle blockage, pressure drop after shot duration of use resulting in reduced impact of the pesticide on pests/insects. he started modifying existing knapsack sprayers in january, 2004 and developed six prototypes. during development of each prototype, he had to say with relatives in pune ( about 350 km from his village) for 10 to 15 days. it took him two years to reach the final version. the improved sprayer has two booms that nearly double the productivity. a second person is needed to simply hold the additional boom. this can be done even by an untrained person. unlike conventional knapsack sprayers, this has provision of changing the stroke length for varying the delivery rate ( depending on crop, environment and maturity level of crop). it also has modified pressure reservoir which results in higher pressure (innovator claims upto 10kg/cm2). spraying at a higher pressure requires lesser pesticide (25 to 30 percent less), and the operation is more effective. it can cover 0.13 ha/h with a single nozzle and over 0.2/h with double nozzle.

title: Bush Cutting cum Pit-drilling Machine

details.full_description: profile mr. h. v. lalzuimawia is a resident of aizawl, mizoram. purpose mizoram primarily has an agricultural economy. the hilly terrain is covered with bushes and creepers. the innovator once visited a village where he noticed farmers struggling to clear the area for cultivating crops. this motivated him to make a device that could make their work easier and faster. this is a portable device for cutting grass/shrub and drilling pits for agriculture and horticulture, usable in hilly areas and rugged terrain of mizoram ( jhum cultivation) and elsewhere. technical details the equipment is powered by a 1.5 hp, 2 stroke petrol engine which uses kerosene to start but runs on petrol. the air-cooled engine has 6000 rpm. it has shoulder straps and back cushion and can be carried on the back. it weighs around four to five kilograms. there are two arms; one for cutting grass and another for drilling pits. benefit bush cutting cum pit-drilling process becomes easy by using this innovation. suggested reading(s): amrutesh, p., sagar, b., & venu, b. title: Blanket washing machine

details.full_description: profile mushtaq ahmad dar,  serial innovator  hailing from south kashmir’s kreeri village from anantnag in j&k, apart is his sensitivity and keen eye for problems. he has come up with a number of practical technological solutions to persistent problems. these include a walnut peeler, a walnut peeler, a walnut cracker and a tree-cum-pole climber, among others. mushtaq started creating devices when he couldn't study beyond class 10 after the untimely death of his father. purpose large mattings/clothes are washed traditionally on concrete space (like roads, floors),  which is a time consuming and very cumbersome to handle. thus we always felt the need for such a machine that would wash large clothes/mats easily.  innovator has developed a machine to wash large clothes/mattings. technical details the working of a machine is that blanket or matting is attached or wound on roller 1 and roller two. open ends are stitched or pinned/sewed. the mat is passed through a plastic brush. the motor is switched on. on rotation one side of the blanket is rubbed by brush inside and the other side is washed brush outside the blanket. meanwhile, water is poured according to need. benefit washing blankets is easy with the use of this innovation. suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). samsung 6.5 kg fully-automatic top loading washing machine (wa65a4002vs/tl, imperial silver, diamond drum). retrieved on august 17, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/samsung-fully-automatic-wa65a4002vs-tl-technology/dp/b08gy3pzqf/ref=asc_df_b08... indiamart, (2021). campaigner laundry washing machine, front loading, automation grade: automatic. retrieved on august 17, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/laundry-washing-machine-8613404188.html?pos=1&kwd=blanket%20was...

title: Mini tiller machine

details.full_description: profile mushtaq ahmad dar,  serial innovator  hailing from south kashmir’s kreeri village from anantnag in j&k, apart is his sensitivity and keen eye for problems. he has come up with a number of practical technological solutions to persistent problems. these include a walnut peeler, a walnut peeler, a walnut cracker and a tree-cum-pole climber, among others. mushtaq started creating devices when he couldn't study beyond class 10 after the untimely death of his father. purpose the technique of hoarsening of soil around the stem of trees by means of spades is a tedious, time consuming and takes a lot of energy. moreover, the soil in the flower beds needs loosening prior to broadcasting. this is done traditionally by means of small spades and consumes a lot of manpower and hence becomes expensive. these activities if done with an efficient instrument becomes expensive. this led the innovator to think of some solution which comes out in the form of the mini tiller. technical details the machine consists of a handle, 4 springs, 2 wheels, 2 pulleys, one belt, one axle and a frame, iron sheet to hold the tiller in position. the tiller consists of fork 4 inches long which penetrates into the soil and hence till it. the machine works on a principle of rotating action of wheels connected with pulley which in turn rotates another pulley and so on. a system of two pulleys finally rotates a tiller which helps in tilling the soil. the tiller is kept in position, the rotational motion of tiller penetrates the forks in soil and loosens it. it can further be penetrated deep or shallow as required. benefit easy to use, reduction of drudgery. suggested reading(s): cherian, a., punnan, j. s., & varghese, a. (2016). a review on power tiller attachments. in kerala technological congress (ketcon-2016 technology for sustainability) . kerala, india. youtube, (2020). agriculture mini power tiller. retrieved on december 17, 2020, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xd3khyzt5q4

title: New turmeric boiler

details.full_description: profile: innovator mr. r. ravi studied up to 8th standard in avalpoondurai village in erode district is a mechanic. he was earlier working as a mechanic in the private industry. now he is running a lathe workshop called a cnc engineering works, avalpoondurai. he has developed a new paddy dryer. purpose: mr. r. ravi made  turmeric boiler to  boil the turmerics for further usage by using a turmeric boil technical specification: farm waste such as dried trashes of turmeric and sugarcane leaves is used as fuel, saving the cost of fuel. about 100 barrels of 200 kg of rhizomes each can be boiled with steam as compared to 25 barrels of 150 kg of rhizomes in the conventional boiling. the steam boiler unit is made of a 5 mm thick iron metal plate. the barrel size is 5 x 4 feet at the top. the turmeric rhizomes are spread out in the top pan for steam boiling. below this, an inner metal pan of size 3 x 2 feet is there for steam production. this unit is put on the furnace. there is an ms pipeline to hold 1000 liters of water for steam production. the heat generated is passed through this pipeline through an outlet for boiling the rhizomes spread in the top pan. after the steam boiling is completed, the upper end of the tube can be taken out so that boiled rhizomes are taken out for sun drying. performance: newly fabricated turmeric boiler using steam for heating the rhizome pan. freshly harvested turmeric rhizomes were soaked in cow dung solution conventionally in a flat pan called "kopparai" in tamil. the rhizomes were boiled along with cow dung solution over a country furnace, using farm waste as fuel for about 45 minutes engaging more labor. one day they were able to boil 20 - 25 barrels of turmeric. in the new turmeric boiler developed by the innovator as steam is used for heating, the time taken to boil is shortened to 8 minutes only. subsequent sun-drying of the steam boiled turmeric rhizomes is quicker than in conventional boiling of rhizomes. benefits: the labor employed for all the processes is relatively lesser than the conventional method. suggested readings: farzana, w., pandiarajan, t., & ganapathy, s. (2018). development of mobile boiling system for turmeric (curcuma longa). innovative food science & emerging technologies, 47 , 428-438. youtube, (2020).  latest technology turmeric cooking boiler. retrieved on february, 15th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cs5xlxo-uxc

title: Branch cutter

title: Weeder

details.full_description: agriculture is the main source of income for farmers in harur. weeding is  major problem for farmers and being labor intensive activity, every farmer needs worker which are in shortage. innovator himself was facing the problem of labor shortage and that inspired him to make machine for weeding. he designed  a machine by passing different stage of his hard work. the mini weeder designed can work between narrow plantation of crops such as sugarcane and maize. the machine is self-propelled and is powered by 3 hp, four stroke motor. the power is transmitted to the gear box by a belt and to the rotating disc from the gear box by a pair of chains. the machine offers auto depth control to weed out in undulating surface by which uniform depth of cutting is maintained in all areas avoiding left over of weed and excess cutting. the effective depth of operation is 5-8 cm in red soil and 5-6 cm in black soil. the average field coverage was found to be 30 cents/hour ( 100 cents = 1 acre). the average weeding efficiency was observed to be 70-75 percent. the fuel consumption is found to be 800-1000 ml/hr.

title: Sugarcane peeler

details.full_description: the innovator has specially designed a machine which removes the skin of sugarcane in just no time. this machine is designed to fulfill a long waiting demand for handy, portable and low cost system to peel the sugarcane. the machine is equally suitable for domestic user and fruit juice maker and of course for temple. the machine runs on a 5 amps plug ( domestic power supply).  it takes hardly two min to peel off a full length of sugarcane of about 6 ft. length

title: Turmeric planter and harvester

details.full_description: the innovator in his childhood was interested in making new gadgets, fond of making clay toys and would make farm implements from clays. he also invents and develops need base implements and tools required in his farming. being a farmer, he used to face problems in harvesting turmeric as it is laborious task and involves timely intervention else it effects the quality of turmeric. further shortage of farm labors, time and cost involved in harvesting is much higher. this motivated him to design turmeric harvester on his own. this tractor drawn implement is used for digging turmeric from the soil. the power is transmitted by means of pto shaft to the gear box to the turmeric digger. the tine penetrates into soil and removes the rhizomes, while rhizome and soil are separated by means of vibrating motion, it causes no damages to the rhizomes. it requires one labor to operate and can harvest around 2 ha/day of the field. the working width is 762 mm and depth is 254 mm. it causes no damages to the rhizomes. it saves around rs.. 3670 per acre if one shift from manual to machine harvesting. the price of the implement is rs.. 55,000.

title: Paddy plant standing stick

details.full_description: profile innovator mr.abdul razak hails from the madurai district of tamil nadu. he is a serial innovator and is locally known as a scientist. since his childhood, mr.abdul razak was passionate about innovation as well as finding alternative solutions for difficult tasks. he has  worked on a number of effective social  innovations purpose to overcome the drudgery faced by men or women in sowing paddy plants, mr.abdul razak has come up with the idea of developing a paddy plant standing stick. with the help of this stick, paddy plants can be sown easily. technical specification the length of this stick is 3ft with lightweight. the measurement of 20 inches scale has been fitted in the paddy plant standing stick for sowing one paddy plant to another paddy plant easily. performance when the men/women take this tool into the field, the paddy is directed towards the mouth of the seeding stick. then the paddy will be flown by a metering mechanism placed inside the handle. this makes the worker sowing very easier and drudgery got reduced. benefits the back pain, hip pain and joint pain of the user can be reduced by this tool. suggested reading(s): rice knowledge bank. transplanting. retrieved on august 17, 2021, from http://www.knowledgebank.irri.org/step-by-step-production/growth/planting/transplanting youtube, (2020). planting rice by hand in rural japan. retrieved on august 17, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hx_fxi-nfxg

title: Super nutmeg desheller

details.full_description: the conventional system of decorticating nutmeg is cracked by tapping the end of the nuts with a small wooden mallet that is very tedious, time consuming and labor intensive process. the innovator in his childhood was involved in decorticating nutmeg so he understood the process very carefully and found that nutmeg when thrown on walls, it hits specific spots, the shell breaks and the kernel is obtained undamaged. this made him think of a suitable machine for easy and speedy decortication of nutmeg. he successfully developed this machine based on his childhood experience.  the machine is capable of decorticating nutmeg without damage and is operated on motor using single phase electric motor. the machine is capable of processing nutmeg about 75 - 150 kg/hr. the efficiency of the machine is found to be 75% in one pass and over 90 % in second pass. this machine helps in enhancing the income of farmers by around 40-50%

title: Seed dispenser for maize in wet lands

details.full_description: purpose: in one of the farmers' meet in bapatla, an agro-based town in guntur, a scientist from agriculture university challenged the farmers to develop a seed dispenser for sowing corn seed in the wet fields immediately after harvest. the scientist explained that if corn sown in the paddy fields within seven days of harvesting the paddy crop with no-tillage, will utilize the residual moisture of the paddy fields for the corn plant to grow. the innovative farmer guravish took up the challenge given open by the scientist and ventured upon making the device as an attachment to the tractor. thus he was successful to develop guraviah's seed drill cum herbi sprayer. technical details: using the existing model available, shri guraviah conceived of an idea to improve the machine so that it dispenses seed at a depth of 3-4 cm, dispenses fertilizer around the seeds, closes the furrow and spray the herbicide solution in the gap between. the machine has toothed wheels attached at: i) one at the end of the shaft of ground wheels, ii) another at the middle of the fertilizer meeting box shaft and iii) another one at the end of the seed metering device shaft. all these wheels are connected by chains. as the ground wheels forward along with the tractor, the chain connection rotates all the shafts. as the shafts rotate, the seed is transferred in required quantities from the seed metering device to the seed tube, the fertilizer is also transferred into a fertilizer tube. both seed and fertilizer reach the rear side of the coulter through tubes, when coulter opens the furrow, seeds and fertilizers are dropped in regular intervals. the ground wheel covers seed and fertilizer with soil. the pump mounted at the rear end of the tractor pumps the herbicide solution in the cans through pipes to the sprayer and thus sprayed in the gap between two furrows.  this device comes as an attachment to the tractor.

title: Wind mill operated water pump

details.full_description: to provide alternative power to farmers innovator shri patan saida has come with an innovation called as wind mill water pump. this wind mill is useful for drawing underground water. wind from any direction will enable the mill to rotate and thus the water is pumped out continuously. this is useful mainly to the farmers. big apartments can also use this for drawing water.

title: Walnut washing machine

details.full_description: profile the innovator showket ahmad  dar is a resident of anantnag, jammu & kashmir. purpose kashmir is well known in the world for the cultivation of many useful plants prominent among them being, saffron, almonds, apple, pears, apricot, and walnuts. walnuts are the backbone of kashmir's economy. the operation after peeling of walnuts is washing the peeled nuts. in conventional ways, walnuts are washed by hands in tubs. these ways are time-consuming and harmful to hands. as such the need has been felt to create a machine that will eliminate the above-said problems. the innovator has come up with an idea and has given a concept of walnut washing machine. technical details as per the innovator, the machine rests on the stand and it consists of a drum, an axle, a lid, a gear system, a handle, an input tray and an assembly of the iron shaft, iron rings, iron net and a perforated lid plate with an output tray also.  the peeled walnuts are supplied to the machine through the input tray and then enter in the drum filled with water. with the help of the rotating mechanism inside the drum, the walnuts are rotated and get washed. benefit walnuts can be washed very easily by this innovation. suggested readings: aliexpress, (2020). vertical single layer fresh walnut peeling machine small household walnut peeling tool. retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.aliexpress.com/item/4000094038986.html youtube, (2020). green walnut peeling and cleaning machine (200 kg/h). retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g7huh-fb3wm youtube, (2015). walnut peeling machine ???? kadioglu walnut huller - cks90d. retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xgb-gqmorn0

title: Agricultural equipment

details.full_description: purpose: in the cultivation process of potato, cabbage, tea, paddy, etc. tilling is an essential activity. tilling manually is a tedious and time-consuming job. to overcome this problem innovator has developed a machine which works mechanically and can till the land easily. performance: it has a capacity of ploughing 3 bighas of land in one hour.

title: Portable winch machine for high tension lines

details.full_description: purpose: normally winch machines used for high tension lines are very large in size and weight. in order to make this system portable and easy to use innovator has developed a portable and small-sized machine with a reduced weight that can be carried to anywhere with the help of a tractor. technical details: the innovator has placed an improved gearbox and two drums for taking the rope. when the pto shaft is connected to the tractor it rotates with high speed and the speed is again manipulated in the normal gear changing gearbox and the shaft from this gearbox is connected to the worm gearbox and its output is connected to the drums which carry the load. performance: the capacity of this winch machine is a minimum of about 3 tons as per the innovator's claim. suggested readings: indiamart, (2021). tractor mounted uprooting winch. retrieved on february, 25th 2021 from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/tractor-mounted-uprooting-winch-12817597488.html rawlinson, r. j. title: Pot mover

details.full_description: in order to ease the shifting of heavy pots of flowering or ornamental plants from one area to another area, innovator has developed an equipment known as pot mover. this innovation can be used even to shift large pots having 50kg weight without touching or even lifting the pots for transporting. pots having top dia. of 8 to 16 inch with any height can be easily shifted to desired place by changing the clamps provided in the equipment with reduced breakage.

title: Low cost drip system

details.full_description: in plantation of tapioca, after digging holes one has to supply water to that holes manually. it requires lot of drudgery, causes back pain if supplied my means of buckets. the innovator decided to supply water by means of hose pipe, but that can actually water one hole at a time. so he thought of making holes at intervals in the pipe and supplying the water through that pipe. it eased the drudgery and speed up irrigating plants. it is an implement designed for irrigating the tapioca plantation. it consists of iron pipe ( length 5300 mm and diameter 30 m) with holes at equal intervals and the holes are covered with plastic bottles. holes in the pipe are flexible, can be changed according to field requirement and are facing upside down to maintain uniform pressure across pipe. it is flexible to shift drip across the height of the plants by use of supporting stick placed at 450 mm from the end. it helps supplying required amount of water and offering individual attention to the plant.

title: Soil filler

details.full_description: traditionally the ploy bag filling is laborious process and requires resting time for increasing efficiency. the innovator has designed an innovation to fill poly bags with ease. it includes an overhead provision to hold the potting mixture and with the help of pedals by comfortably sitting on chair, the potting mixture can be filled easily to the poly bags. with a single filling of the overhead container a minimum of 1000 bags of size 7 x 5 inch can be filled. 350 bags can be filled /hr. one more advantage of the machine is that no external source of power is required for its operation.

title: Animal/bird repeller for agricultural use

details.full_description: many farmers are suffering from animals and birds eating/spoiling the crops which make him/her to maintain dedicated persons continously monitoring the land from birds and animals, even at nights as well.  the innovator has given an engineering solution which gives unique frequency as well as unique opponent to animal sounds that could make the life of suffering farmers far easier. the device can be operated in auto mode or manual mode. it has eight speakers which works in sequence or in random mode. the device can be used for different crops and also can be used as animal repellant just by changing the memory chip. hence the device a multi-use device.

title: Running Tubewell using Solar Power

details.full_description: profile innovator mr velayatham   is from pudukkottai district of tamil nadu. purpose: while reading an article of mr. ahmad in newspaper who driven a car by using solar power. this inspired the innovator and taking advantage of this opportunity to serve the farmers of tamilnadu by developing a tube well that will operate on solar power using remote control switch. technical details: he uses a solar operated pump to lift the water from tube well by using remote switch. benefits it is eco friendly. suggested readings: harishankar, s., kumar, r. s., sudharsan, k. p., vignesh, u., & viveknath, t. title: Solar sprayer

details.full_description: purpose: mallesh (famous innovator of remote for lights and fans) has made a solar sprayer for farmers. technical details: it has 12v, 7a battery and dc dynamo. 10w solar panel has been used. the battery can be charged from ac also. 4 hours back-up charge available and while spraying it gets charged continuously. this is very silent and has a 16 liters tank. the total weight is around 20 kg with a container full. benefits: as compared to petrol-driven sprayers it pollutes less with less noise.

title: simple hole digger

details.full_description: conventionally plantation requires digging of holes by means of shovels or other equipments. it causes back pain, involves lot of drudgery and also needs a huge labour. deriving the mechanism of screws, the innovator designed the digging implement that can dig the hole by standing without much pain. it is a device designed for digging holes that is useful for planting logs of tapioca. it consists of a metal needle, iron rope and auger like ms plate wing. the detachable auger like ms plate of helical profile having circumference of 250 mm is designed to make a bore of 300 mm. a needle of 100 mm length is attached to one end of the ms blade wing and the wing is attached to the pipe of diameter 20 mm and length 1450 mm. the needle with helical profile at the bottom is inserted into the soil by drilling action to make at a depth ( 100 mm) and 300 mm diameter. a single person can dig 4500 holes in 5-6 hours. the weight of the implement is only 3 kg.

title: Bulgar Alarm

details.full_description: the innovator is running a petti shop in thiruvarumbur near tiruchi. he has been reading newspaper regularly and he had come across lot theft case reports and he was wondering how to prevent such burglary. with his full zeal and zest he has been successful in developing a prototype gradually a device - burglary alarm. the prototype is box like instrument. whenever weight is placed or pressed on the box, it produces alarm. this alarm rings due to spring attached below the box. it is be charged for 5 hrs. for proper function. the bell is set to ring for 10 seconds. this buglar alarm box is placed near bero, cash box in front and back door of the house. when the thief approaches over it. it produces alarm that alerts the owner. this alarm can be used in banks, atms, houses and even in farms to prevent the animals from entering into the field.

title: Arecanut plate making machine

details.full_description: profile innovator mr.chinnakannu, belongs to a prosperous region of namagiripettai near rasipuram. this village is located near the kollimalai hills where the people are mainly involved in tapioca harvesting, arecanut harvesting etc., purpose mr.chinnakannu in his routine job of maintenance once came across leaf moulding machine. the machine involves lot of drudgery as the plates were moulded using manual power, requires lot of maintenance and was of low productivity. he found potential in this machine and decided to reduce the drudgery by using hydraulic mechanism. with the use of hydraulic mechanism the productivity improved, drudgery reduced, maintenance lowered and female can operate without any stress. technical specification the machine is used for moulding leafs to make plates of size ranging from 4" to 12 " diameter. the assembly consists of parallel arrangement of moulds top and bottom, operated by 2 hp motor and pedal to lower and lift the pressing and cutter bar. the machine uses electric power and hydraulic mechanism to mold leaf. the temperature controller is made up of simple electric circuit and is useful in maintaining the quality of plates by removing the moisture content. performance it can produce 1700 plates/ day. the machine has advantage over others as it has reduced space and increased productivity with parallel arrangement of moulds. benefits it can be used for producing variety of crockery items like  spoons, cups, plates etc. suggested readings: nikhil, r., raahul, n., sateesh, n., shivpriyan, m., clein, t., tang, a., & pramod, r. title: Loop type of Weeder

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. varikkat sukumaran mahesh hails from idukki district of kerala. purpose weeding a main intercultural operation which is very tedious, time consuming. scarcity  of labour and not performing the operation in time made  innovator think of other alternatives and he succeeded in developing a low cost loop type weeder. technical details the low cost weeder is wooden cylindrical drum with a central hole through its axis. the drum is covered with gi sheet on all sides. on the periphery of inverted "u" shaped loops made with 3 mm gi wire are fixed at specific pattern. the loops are fixed in such a manner that the first one at the centre, followed by two loops on sides and again one at centre and son on. a shaft is passed through centre hole on which the drum rotates . the shaft is mounted on frame to which a long handle is welded. plain washers are provided on both sides of the shaft between drum and frame so that free motion is obtained. weeding is achieved by the to and fro motion of the weeder between plants. this way the weeder uproots the weeds and buries them in mud. due to its small size the  weeder can be used even in paddy fields. benefits it is cheap and fast. suggested readings: tradeindia, (2021). wolf garten garden tiller manual weeder two devices in one effortlessly loosen retrieved on march, 16th  2021 from https://www.tradeindia.com/products/wolf-garten-garden-tiller-manual-weeder-6549903.html youtube, (2015). true temper stirrup hoe official product review retrieved on march, 16th  2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vxgw-znlpjm

title: Cassava stem cutter

details.full_description: cassava is raised by planting its stem which is in turn cut into small pieces of about 2-3" length. it is usually cut through manual method. innovator p. ravikumar has designed cassava cutter to make planting material for raising cassava crop. the machine is operated by 1 hp motor of 2800 rpm. for planting 1 acre 4800 sets are required and it is possible by this machine to produce by using a single labour in 1 hour. whereas in conventional methods, 2 labour is needed to complete this task in four hours.

title: Tapioca chips cutting machine
keywords: cutting devices for fruits and vegetables

details.full_description: purpose: in namakkai district, tapioca is used as a raw material to convert it into starch, sago and other byproducts. due to distress sale value of tapioca, district magistrate and agriculture department officials insisted the farmers to look for alternative. the alternative was to make chips and dry products used as animal feed. earlier chips were made manually which requires lot of drudgery, involves health hazards, consumes lot of time and non uniformity of the output. technical details: innovator designed a machine that could consume very less power and gives variable sizes of finished products ( 2mm - 25 mm). this machine is capable for processing tapioca into chips of adjustable thickness (2mm - 25mm) and it is capable to cut vegetables and fruits. this machine has a capacity to process 200 kg/hr of tapioca and 100 kg/hr of vegetables and fruits. this machine is portable (50 kg in weight) so it can be used for processing raw material at the pint of origin/source. benefits: it can run on electricity, fuel or by embedding cycling mechanism. suggested readings: aajjo, (2021). potato chips machine. retrieved on february, 25th 2021 from https://www.aajjo.com/food-processing-plants-and-machinery_potato-chips-machine youtube, (2019). tapioca slicer chips machine. retrieved on february, 25th 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fse3hybfiws

title: Low cost water filter

details.full_description: profile liandailova is a resident of mizoram. purpose in the village of innovator, the problem with the drinking water was that when the water they pumped first it appears transparent and pure in the morning. in the evening it turned yellowish in color and by the passage of time the water becomes nasty and unable to drink due to bad smell. the water was not only unsafe for drinking, they also don't like to use it even for washing. the innovator tried to develop a system for the purification of water. he recalled what his father had told him in his childhood which was to " put a lot of charcoal in a well and make another hole at the bottom, then the water that flows through that hole is very tasty and pure. this encouraged him to make a new water filter in the future. technical details he suggests striking a nail three or four times at the bottom of a big vassal to make hole. then put a cloth to cover the hole. after that sand taken from the river should be put inside the vessel and it should be two inches thick. then put a lot of washed charcoal at the upper side of the sand. since the charcoal is very light and can easily float, put chips of rock at the upper side of the charcoal to prevent it from floating and filter the water. to have water source put another vessel full of water with a small hole at its bottom over the top of the first vessel. benefit the water which comes out of the filter is very pure, healthy and fresh. suggested reading(s): lifschitz, e. l. title: Electric rubber tapping knife

details.full_description: rubber tapping is the process by which latex is collected from a rubber tree. the economy of kerala is dependent on revenue from cultivation of rubber. however the cost of cultivation as well as collection of yield has gone high. with scarcity of skilled labor, non-availability of modern tools and equipment for tapping rubber and an advertisement from rubber board, kerala inviting innovative prototype for tapping rubber motivated him to accept the challenge. he made the model for rubber tapping. the implement is capable of making groove in the tree to tap the rubber latex. currently it is powered and driven by battery. the machine consists of a curved plate, 5 watt dc motor, drill bit, 12 vol 7aamp battery, coupling and a wire. innovator has provided a curved plate considering curvature of stem of a rubber plant. the cutter of the machine automatically adjust to the width of the tapping channel which will prevent the tree from getting punctured as in case of ordinary tapping lachines. a drill bit is rotated by the motor powered by battery and is used to cut rubber bark  very gently avoiding losses. as per the innovator's claim it takes only 5 seconds to tap one rubber tree.

details.full_description: a large number of laboureres both men and women remain engaged in collection of sea-shell from rivers as it is used for broiler feed in poultry farms and prawn farms for feed. this feed is manufactured from boiled sea-shell and normally women workers manufacture this feed manually, but one person can only manufacture 500 grams per hour and this quantity is not sufficient. the innovator tried to innovate a low cost sea-shell culturing machine for manufacturing a good quantity of feeds using this machine. the machine is powered by electric motor and it separates the flesh and shells from boiled sea-shell. it produces about 160 kg of feed per hour.

title: Green wainum

details.full_description: in the state of manipur availabilities of lpg is very limited. so firewood, charcoal, rice husk are normally used for cooking purpose. and in fact 99% people of the people of manipur live on rice. its cover i.e. husk is no doubt available abundantly everywhere. people  use to throw it away as waste material. this let the innovator to focus on modernize the old rice husk stove and he succeeded to develop a new rice husk stove which he gave name as " green wainum ( wai = husk, nam = stove). it is an indigenous technology. it is simple device which consists of perforated internal cylinder having dimensions 11.5 cm in dia x 76.2 cm height. base of the cylinder is supported by a mesh which acts as supporting wall for rice husk and air passage channel blown by a dc fan powered by a 12 volt battery. rice husk is filled in the furnace and dc fan attached to the sideway bottom of the furnace is connected to battery. then the furnace is ignited using small paper. it can produce smokeless blue colour flame. other than rice husk, saw dust and dried fodder can also be used with similar efficiency.

title: Mechanical hoe

details.full_description: weeds are unwanted and undesirable plants which interfere in the cultivation of plants, vegetables etc. weeding is traditionally done in many ways like hand weeding, hand hoeing, digging, cutting etc. but at the these processes of weeding require time and labour. to overcome the drudgeries faced by weeding the innovator has fabricated a tool called it as mechanical hoe. the tool is working mechanically. with the use of this tool farmer can work at high speed. the tool is light in weight and easily portable.  the tool constitutes mainly three parts i.e. motor, shaft cable and circular hoe.  the function of motor is to rotate shaft through shaft cable which in turn rotates the circular hoe. the end of the shaft rod constitutes spiral toothed pulley structure which slides over the spiral toothed structure of circular hoe. in this way the shaft rod rotates circular hoe. the circular hoe is rounded pertains 2 to 6 hoe blades. when the hoe rotates, the blades dig the soil up to some depth and the weeds are pulled out automatically. there will be choice of hoe size i.e. the with of hoe can range from 3 inch to 10 inches and are used according to need.

title: Manual compressor

title: Two in one motor for pumping well water and wastewater

details.full_description: profile: innovator mr. jayaprakash observed that in rasipuram town panchayat, there was a lot of drainage water stagnating in the outskirt of the town. this water also leads to breeding of mosquitoes. he wanted to use the waste water by mixing with fresh water for agricultural purposes. purpose: to utilize wasted water at outskirt of innovator's place. also to avoid mosquito breeding in wasted stagnant water. technical specification: there are 3 valves and by adjustment mechanism we can either allow only well water for crops or allow waste water or both waste water and well water together. he suggests that we should not use only waste water for crop cultivation but may be restricted to less than 25 percent of total times of irrigation, otherwise it will lead to deposition of residues. performance: for this idea, a farmer in the same area accepted and innovator installed valve / outlet system in the pipeline so that when motor ( pump set ) is on, it will suck well water and enter into the delivery pipe and goes up to waste water tank. benefits: this system avoids breeding of mosquitoes over the stagnant water and this water can be redirected to the waste water tank and can be used for irrigation purpose.

title: Hydrogen based engine

details.full_description: profile - mr. govindsingh malaviya is creative and innovative since his childhood. he always tried to do something which is creative and provide a solution to an existing problem. he did lots of jobs like rickshaw driver, fruit and vegetable vendor for his livelihood. during this period too he tried to develop something which solves problems. technical details out of this, he developed an engine that operates on water. for this, he uses a mixing unit, reactor, condenser, leak detector, and global atmosphere charger. these five units are assembled in common gasoline engine. the reactor is used to generate hydrogen by chemical reaction of caustic, aluminum and water. we first mix caustic and aluminum in a cylinder and air packed the cylinder and the water is mix in aluminum and caustic by a regulator. the above mechanism produces 100-gram hydrogen by using 1 liter of water. this generated hydrogen gas is stored and cooled in the condenser where it is cooled to -260 degree celcius. then this hydrogen gas is converted into liquid hydrogen. this condensation process is carried out using nitrogen. then 99% of fresh air is mixed with 1% hydrogen liquid. then this fuel is sparked in the combustion chamber. after sparking, this fuel burns out and provide thrust to the piston and so on. the leak detector is used to detect any leak in the system for safety purposes. benefits reduces greenhouse gas emissions. suggested readings: szwaja, s., & grab-rogalinski, k. title: Garlic clove separator

details.full_description: profile innovator rambikas kumar is a farmer and he has the nature of inventing new things and experimenting with new ideas. the innovator comes to sabzi mandi in delhi to sell vegetables. while one such visit, he saw that women are employed to separate the cloves of garlic and sell it in mandi. he found that paying the daily wage reduces his earning but if do not separate the cloves no one will buy it from him, hence he came up with the idea of the machine. purpose the innovator has developed a machine that can separate the cloves of garlic in very little time. technical details the machine has a roller with handle. it uses a rolling mechanism to separate cloves by using pressure only. it has a handle, a serrated roller, and a flat base. it has two versions: manually operated and motorized. the top hopper is used to kept garlic inside the machine. then garlic cloves are forwarded to the gap between two rollers surrounded by dotted surface. here the actual separation of garlic cloves takes place. benefits its design is very simple and can be manufactured very easily. suggested reading(s): alias, t., eldhose, m., krishnan, n., & harikrishnan, v. k.
