title: Mushroom compost turning machine

details.full_description: profile innovator jitender malik started mushroom cultivation in the year of 1996, after learning techniques of cultivation from his maternal uncle in himachal pradesh. mushroom cultivation needs preparation of quality compost that can be of optimum utility for mushroom cultivation. purpose when he started mushroom cultivation he realized that it is difficult to retain labor for compost making, hence he kept thinking of making a compost making a machine that operates automatically. he made machines on trial and error basis. but they can operate only on dry compost. in 2008, he again faced the same labor problem for compost making. so he tried to make such a machine that ultimately provide a solution. he borrowed money from his brother to make a machine. technical details this is an electrically operated machine that moves in a straight line cutting through compost heap, turning and mixing all material, adding moisture whenever required and heaping it back in line. the machine has two motors, drum with blades, conveyor belt to make compost.10 hp motor is used to rotate the blades and another motor 2 hp to power rear wheels. a drum with blades is fixed at its periphery at compost strikes to a net covering on top of the drum because of which clods in the compost are broken. on the side of net, there is a nozzle with a pipe, to spray water or chemical to kill the fungus inside compost. a conveyor belt is attached at the rear side of the drum for collecting turned compost. benefit difficulty to retain labor for compost making can be reduced by this innovation. suggested readings: indiamart, (2021). compost turner. retrieved on february, 23rd 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/compost-turner-20313046012.html youtube, (2015).  compost turning machine by dairam sons. retrieved on february, 23rd 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fdvx2somtz0

title: Water heater

details.full_description: profile innovator paras ram studied primary education till 5th class and is involved in farming. purpose he found his beloved wife struggling with the smoke inside the kitchen to supply food and hot water to the entire family. it was then he thought of why not cover the chullah with something so that smoke goes out of the house. in 2010 innovator came up with a box covering chullah. later he found that all the vessels placed around chullah becomes hot and he understood that box chullah generates enough heat to provide a sufficient amount of heat to the surrounding. this observation ignited thought in his mind and he came up with his innovation named water heater. technical details he made a rectangular structure with joining pipes at the right angle with each other. iron shaft attaches to the long arm of the pipe. the machine has an elevated pipe attached perpendicularly to one short arm of a rectangle. this pipe acts as the inlet of the machine. there is also another small pipe that is attached right with the opposite arm of the machine at the perpendicular direction. this pipe acts as an outlet. this entire rectangular mechanism is placed around box chullah. benefit it is a very  simple mechanism but equally effective and efficient. everyone can afford it. suggested readings: youtube, (2019). instant water heater geyser retrieved on march, 22nd  2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5-qyj6irlns youtube, (2017). wood fire hot water heater - hammam. retrieved on march, 22nd  2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k3hglbajb24

title: Air cooler with oxygen providing plants

details.full_description: technical details: the innovation relates to an eco-friendly cooler. the cooler body is divided into two parts. the back part of the body contains plants that generate fresh oxygen. the front part contains the fan and cooling jackets.  an overhead tank, through copper tubes, sprays water on the cooling jackets. the water from the cooling jackets, which is thus cold is collected into the lower tank. a filtration unit is attached. after filtration, the water can be used for drinking purposes. a mosquito-killing kit is also provided which is operated for a stipulated period of time. this helps in killing the mosquitoes of the room and the cooler. the system has been tested to provide 50l of cold water per hour. it is a low-cost multi- applicability cooler which is also good for health.

title: Insect repellent mask for safe agricultural practice

details.full_description: profile the innovator mr. ananda s jheertan is a 10th class student and having an idea for the masking the crop by applying the net with cream to control the pest. purpose and technical details the innovation relates to a uniquely devised farm practice against pest protection of plants. the methods presently in use do not specify the quantity and are harmful for plants. this technique makes use of a camouflage net made of jute. jute has very high water retention capacity and allows easy airflow and sunlight to enter for photosynthesis. it can also withstand a good amount of heat. the plants are first covered with a protection net devised out of jute. a solution prepared from n- diethyl benzamide is then sprayed on the jute net. the net retains the solution and helps to keep insects away from the plant and the pungent smell of the solution remains even after a few washes. thus prolonging the insect attack with minimal usage of harmful chemicals. suggested readings: msangi, s., kweka, e., & mahande, a. (2018). repellent activity of trig (n-n diethyl benzamide) against man-biting mosquitoes. journal of tropical medicine , 2018, 9037616.

title: Strip system of wheat sowing

details.full_description: profile - mr. narayan singh patel, the farmer, lives in karakbel, madhya pradesh which is a small village in which hindi is the local language and farming is a prevalent occupation. since childhood, he is trying to develop new things related to farming. he has received a number of certificates, awards for developing new ideas in farming. genesis- the innovator was using conventional seed drill which can sow seed at a distance of 18 inches. the innovator has faced problems during intercultural operation due to less spacing between two rows, so the innovator has modified the seed opener of existing available seed to solve his problems. purpose of this technology  - this is a tractor-mounted modified seed drill which can be used to sow a wheat crop. the seed drill was modified by providing structural components at the bottom tines of seed drill to increase the production of crop. using the modified seed dispenser/ broadcaster, seeds can be sown in a strip of 15 cm, which results in an increased probability of germination and hence the yield. performance - the modified seed drill can cover 1.25 - 1.5 acres per hour with the fuel consumption of 2.5 to 3 l/h. the production is claimed to increase by 28%. benefits- it is a new concept in which the broadcasting of the seed can be done by providing a removable box at the opener of the seed drill. as per the claim, the modified method broadcasts the seed away from each other because of which the plants compete for less among one other and there is a greater rate of germination. it can be used for sowing different crops which can be sown by the broadcasting method suggested readings: dhartiagroengg, (n.d.). 7 row tractor drawn seed cum fertilizer drill. retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.dhartiagroengg.com/tractoroperated-automaticseedcum-fertilizer-drill.html youtube, (2020). bhoomi agro auto seed drill/automatic perni yantra/adhunik sheti avjare/vaibhav auto and agro. retrieved on february, 10th 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3-liihod5v0 youtube, (2018). bharat agro - title: Macha Ibema Khudi Thibi Foot operated water lifting pump

details.full_description: profile innovator khomdram mr. rishikanta singh hails  from imphal district of manipur. purpose mr. rishikanta singh has developed a double piston pump, which lift the water individually turn by turn and provide water through single outlet. technical  specification the pump is operated by foot lever. it works asynchronously with the exertion of pressure on paddle levers. each pump works on paddle levers. each pump work independently to draw water but drawn water is directed to single outlet so create enough water pressure. water can be drawn upto 15 meter. it is paddle powered water pump. whole assembly is made up of metal iron. it consists of two horizontal semi-cylindrical water chambers and two paddle levers. cylindrical pumps are mounted vertically on one of the horizontal water chamber is mounted on upper ends of the vertical pumps. paddle levers are connected to pistons inside vertical pumps. lower chamber acts as inlet chamber and upper chamber acts as outlet water chamber. an inlet pipe is attached to lower portion of lower water chamber and an outlet pipe is attached to upper water chamber.  cylindrical vertical pumps assembly consist of hollow pipe piston positioned inside each of vertical pipes. suction pressure is created by with the stroke of paddle levers. whole pump assembly consists of 2 one-way rubber valves which are attached between connecting portion of vertical pipes with the lower water chamber. upper ends of pistons is attached a one-way valve. two numbers of valves are attached a lower portion of upper water chamber between connecting portion of upper water chamber with vertical pipes. benefits easy to use with less maintenance. it will ease the operation drawing water from tube-well or any other water source.. title: Automatic air releaser in compressor motor

details.full_description: compressor is widely used to draw water from the borewell in the agriculture sector. water is pumped out because of the air pressure in the compressor. the compressor can run only after the release of air. if an automatic air releaser is fitted, it will be more helpful for the farmer especially in drought hit areas. if the  air is not released, there is possibility of burning of coil due non release of air and also the electric motor may stop function. the innovator has given the design for a new automatic air releaser as follows: it is a rectangular steel box. there are two holes on each side i.e. front side and back side of the box.  one hole is for the air to come inside and another is for the  air to go out. there is a third hole in the middle of the box. through this, air will go to borewell. a piston is fitted inside the centre part.  its length is designed in such a way that it can close or open the hole in the steel box and  is structured in a way that air from the compressor is sent into the air releaser. when the air rushes inside the air releaser, the piston inside is pushed and the air goes into the borewell and subsequently water comes out as usual. when the piston is pushed in this manner, it is designed to close the second end of the piston to avoid air release. thus air is released without any farmer's effort.  hence the work burden is less.  with the release of the air, the automatic starter won't find any difficulty in starting again.  so it is not necessary for the farmers to go there and release the air form the compressor.

title: 4-stage rain water harvester

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. vasanthi ravindran hails from cochin district of kerala. purpose mr. vasanthi ravindran has designed a 4-stage rainwater harvester to save water and increase the ground water level. technical details in this designed filter wherein a valve is fitted on the down pipe from the roof top. the valve is to be kept open during initial rain until the roof is cleaned out. the wastewater goes to the tree bases. this valve is then closed and the water will be directed to the first stage filter. the first stage consists of a fine stainless steel sieve formed like pipe and housed in a pvc pipe. one end  is connected to a tee above the valve. the other end is connected to an elbow and then to a pvc pipe vertically down. he water is filtered through the sieve and flows down through a tee at the middle of the first filter and enters the second stage. the second stage consists of a moulded pvc housing with upper and lower portions fastened by stainless steel bolts and nuts. the water goes through the granular activated carbon contained in the housing which will absorb the harmful organic chemicals coming down with rain from the atmosphere. after the second stage a bypass is fitted through tee connection. a valve similar to the fist flush valve, is fixed after the bypass connection. by closing this valve, the entire water will be directed towards recharging the earth. the housing at the third stage consists of a moulded pvc housing with upper and lower portion, fastened by the stainless steel bolts and nuts. a number of strainers made of polypropylene are fixed in the housing for greater flow. the fourth stage consists so a similar housing as of the second stage. this contains a number of micro filter cartridges made of polypropylene to stop all other sediments in the water. the filtered water is then stored in a sump of required capacity. a drain valve is also attached to the fourth housing. it is kept free from sunshine the water and  can be used for a long term. it is safe to boil this water for drinking purposes. benefits: it can help us to overcome the problem of water crisis. suggested readings: ward, s., memon, f. a., & butler, d. (2010). rainwater harvesting: model-based design evaluation. water science and technology , 61 (1), 85-96. youtube, (2019).  rainwater harvesting with 4 step systems of rpv wisyretrieved on february, 26th 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=77rujdnj8-w youtube, (2011). 12 steps to creating the complete rain harvesting system. retrieved on february, 26th 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivpuu-wl--4

title: Winnowing Fan

details.full_description: profile bashir ahmad ahangar is a resident of badgam, jammu & kashmir. purpose in kashmir, the traditional method of winnowing is to raise the mixture to a certain height in a shaped basket and is shaken and dropped on the ground. the lighter chaff is blown away while the heavier grains fall down. the separation will not take place if there is no wind and thus wind is the determining factor in the process. the innovator thought of a fan that will increase the efficiency of the method. the user has no longer to wait for the wind to come. it is a fan raised on an iron stand which will provide a sufficient amount of air for the winnowing process. technical details the main parts of the winnower are iron stand, two gear wheels ( big & small), two axels and a fan with big blades. the gear wheels are attached to the stand through the axels and bearings are used at the points where axle joins the stand. the arrangement is such that the handle is used to rotate the big gear wheel which in turn rotates the small gear wheel and the fan which is parallel on the same axle. the gear wheels are so attached that it increase the rpm of the fan with little effort. benefit the winnower is easily detachable and handy to carry to the fields. suggested readings: lutu, a., bagnulo, m., cid-sueiro, j., & maennel, o. title: Combine thresher, harvester & chaff cutter

details.full_description: profile- innovator is aware of the various problems that occur in farming. after harvesting, most of the farmers put fire on their farm. due to this method one day there was an accident that took place in the nearby village which destroyed many of the farms. because of this tragedy, the idea of making combined harvester came in the mind of an innovator. purpose- the machine made by the innovator can do simultaneously operation of harvesting, threshing, winnowing & preparation of straw. this can reduce drudgery to farmers as well as women labor to a large extent. this machine consists of three units: harvesting unit, conveying unit and threshing unit and a conventional thresher as a threshing unit. cereal crops are gathered in by the header in the front, which has a pair of sharp pincers called crop dividers at either end. the cutter bar runs the entire length of the header; its moving fingers open and close repeatedly to cut off the crops at their base and convey vertically to one end and withdraws the crops on a conveyor belt. the cut crop travels up through conveyor to the processing mechanism inside the threshing unit. a threshing drum beats the cut crop and separates the grains from stalks. the grains fall through sieves into a collecting tank. the straw chaff, after being cut into small pieces, falls from the thresher at the back of the machine and gets collected into a separate tank. performance- this is then used as animal feed. one acre of land can be harvested in 1 hour with fuel consumption of 4 liters per hour.

details.full_description: profile the innovator is a farmer residing in meerut district of uttar pradesh. purpose at the time of the riots in his area he was unable to go out side in the market for buying diesel for his farm machinery. hence, he thought about other alternatives rather than fuel and animals and came up with an idea of solar powered battery operated cultivator. technical description the machine is a solar powered cultivator which uses two solar panels of 24v, 50 w. the machine also consists of two batteries of 12 v. the batteries supply power to motor. a gear box with ratio of 15:1 is attached with motor to reduce rpm. the machine takes two hours to do intercultural operation or shallow ploughing ( in soft soil) of 1 acre field with fully charged batteries without solar panel. the panel can directly run the machine or it can charge batteries to run machine. benefits the machine is useful for shallow ploughing and weeding in maize, sugarcane, orchards etc.

title: cow dung pot making machine

details.full_description: profile innovator is ahmedabad, gujarat. purpose conventionally plastic bags are used to grow/sell saplings in nurseries. plastic bags have nil porosity, are not bio-degradable hence not eco-friendly. moreover, after germination, the bag has to be torn off to facilitate root growth and in case the bag is not torn properly the plant gets damages. as an alternative to plastic bags. technical details innovator came up with the idea of cow dung pot. the innovation lies in achieving an optimum combination of cow dung and other binders in the mixture, making it sturdy and pest resistant. innovator has developed a manually operated cow dung pot making a machine that increases production and eliminates intensive labour. a combination of cow dung, straw ( or any agro waste/ harvested cop residues), binders and pest controllers are filled into the die. the mixer is then compressed by a screw mechanism against the die to mould its shape and then taken out of the die with the help of a peddling lever. produced pots are then sun-dried to make hard and sturdy. benefits it is bio-degradable, environment-friendly and provides nutrition to saplings. the water absorption rate of pots is very low which prevents leaching of nutrients. the pots are easy manufactures and hence provide a greater opportunity for employment in rural india. various size of pots is possible in a single machine. the machine is easy to use with low maintenance and has a uniform quality of pots. suggested readings: indiamart, (2021). manual cow dung pot making machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021 from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/cow-dung-pot-making-machine-19982014730.html youtube, (2015). cow dung pot making machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qoak1bvihr8 youtube, (2019). cowdung pots  retrieved on february, 22nd 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oxifebi_lnc

title: Rice cleaning /grading machine

details.full_description: purpose- in the process of sorting grains, husk and stones need to be removed and grains are divided into separate grades like good grains, broken grains, black ( inedible ) grains, etc. in this process, the husk is removed by winnowing and seeds are sorted manually. the innovator shri mohan sharma has come up with the solution and introduced a device by using the principle of winnowing which can separate husk and stones. this is a hand-driven cum motorized rice grain sorting device which is made of wood. the blower fan is provided to perform winnowing operation which can separate the husk from grains. a separate compartment with a separate outlet is given to sort grains in different grades. the device has the ability to sort 400 to 450 kg of rice per hour into different grades like clean grain, broken grain, inedible grain, stones, and husk.

title: Multiple utilities of paddy broken machine

details.full_description: purpose- this is a paddy machine that has been designed for collecting the clean fresh whole rice and 1/4th portion broken rice separately from the paddy. by using this machine 15 quintal rice is collected within one hour and also it can be fresh rice free from the dust and also other unnecessary ingredients.

title: Cow dung log making machine

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. mansukhbhai prajapati hails from rajkoot  district of  gujarat. purpose conventionally firewood, electricity or lpg gas is used for cremation purposes. indian people prefer traditional products for cremation e.g. wooden logs and dried cow dung logs. also, cremation using cow dung logs less compared to firewood or other means. this lead to a greater demand for cow dung. the problem of making the cow dung logs through some mechanism strike to the shri mansukhbhai prajapati and lead him to develop a machine that makes long cow dung logs with minimum human intervention. technical details in this machine, a combination of cow dung and straw ( or any agro waste / harvested crop residues) is fed into the hopper of the machine. the mixture is then compressed and extruded out with the help of a screw mechanism which produces logs of different shape and size.  the innovator is working on an improved model to replace the belt pulley mechanism with a gearbox that will be driven by a motor. benefits it is eco-frendly  and easy to use device. suggested readings: indiamart, (2021). manual cow dung pot making machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021 from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/cow-dung-pot-making-machine-19982014730.html youtube, (2015). cow dung pot making machine. retrieved on february, 22nd 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qoak1bvihr8 youtube, (2019). cowdung pots  retrieved on february, 22nd 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oxifebi_lnc

title: Sprayer for orchards

details.full_description: the innovator realized while talking with farmers that the sprayers used by them do not perform efficiently and most of the liquid pesticides get dispersed into the air and thus wasted. this triggered him to develop a device which can overcome this problem and work efficiently with proper spraying of pesticides on the plants.  this device is a blowing sprayer which can be used in orchard crops with the help of tractor of 18 hp and bigger size. the sprayer consists of a blower, pump, tank, gear assembly and nozzles connected to high pressure pipe line. there are two radial fans mounted on the both sides to obtain better efficiency and effectiveness by sporting pesticides on orchard crops. it  has also a provision of rotating blower (fan) along with nozzles to spray pesticides in all directions. the sprayer can be used for spraying pesticides in crops like grapes, mango, sapota, pomegranate etc. the sprayer requires 100-125 litre of pesticide for one acre of land.

title: Without screw to use Asbestos in Bamboo made house

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. krishna barman hails from coach behar district of west bengal. purpose when we use asbestos then the wooden frame is required. it is tied by screw. but many villagers have not enough money in their hands to use wooden frames because wood is very expensive and also the carpenter charges high. krishna barman the innovator has made a substitute plan. he has made a bamboo frame where asbestos is setting strongly without screw. it is very strong as same as the wooden frame. technical details to make this, bamboo sticks should be cut according to need and it should be cut as hook shape i.e. it looks like a key. then another side should be tied strongly with the down bamboo. asbestos should be tied with the hook on both sides. by adopting this process, the house should be kept in rescue mode. benefits it is very strong as same as the wooden frame.

title: Sugar cane juice extraction machine powered by engine of vehicle

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. ganga singh is from muktsar district of punjab purpose mr. ganga singh has developed a machine that is used to extract juice from sugarcane. technical details this device is used to extract juice from sugarcane. innovator has used various parts of maruti car. the juice extractor is placed at the left side of the vehicle and powered by engine by connecting them by crank shaft. the innovator claims to get advantage that while transporting some luggage in vehicle we can extract the juice at the same time. suggested reading(s): azeez, n.a, okpara, i.n, ologunye, o.b. (2019). design and fabrication of sugarcane juice extractor. american journal of engineering research 8 (7), 91-97 youtube. (2018). sugarcane juice machine on a car retrieved on december 15, 2020, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hoxvwivhphy

title: Weeding and ploughing machine

details.full_description: the innovator observed that most of weeding operations in farm are done manually or by bullock drawn implements. this is a time consuming process. so he thought to make such implement/weeder which can be used easily for weeding and also for shallow ploughing. the tractor drawn inter-row weeder was developed by the innovator to perform cutting of weeds and to get better pulverizing of soil. this multi-row rotary weeder consists of a set of cutting blades, which penetrate into the soil and remove the weeds in crop rows. the weeder can be attached with tractor of minimum 25 hp and it can be used for weeding in crop cotton, paddy, pulses, tomato, sugarcane and various other plant fields. the developed weeder has weeding efficiency of 80 %, field efficiency of 94 % and effective field capacity of 1.008 ha per hour.

title: Ginger and turmeric planter

details.full_description: conventionally labourers dig soil  and sow ginger/turmeric. this is a tedious and time consuming task. as the sowing task is undertaken in a back bending posture, problems of back pain have been reported by labourers. in order to reduce these drudgeries faced by the workers and increase the out, innovator inderjit decided to work on solution of this problem and developed a ginger/turmeric sowing machine. it is a tractor mounted turmeric/ginger planter with adjustable row spacing from 4.5 to 5.5 ft. and plant to plant spacing (,9, 12 inches). there are two furrow openers. the planter along with tractor requires 5 manpower ( including diver) to do plantation in 4 acres per day ( 8hrs), while as the conventional manual method needs 110-120 manpower for the same work.

title: Onion and garlic digger

details.full_description: innovator due to poor economic conditions of the family  was compelled to leave the studies and engaged in farming activities. but he was not interested in doing farming operations manually, specially hoeing and weeding.  hence he tried to develop devices to speed up the task and he was working on his ideas and innovations.  while doing harvesting of onion/garlic, separation of leaf/stalk from the bulbs is a tedious task and involves huge manpower. if not processed properly the onion fetches less market price. if the onion is dug along with the leaves, separation of soil from the onion is difficult job. in order to mechanize the process, the innovator has developed two machines; one is for cutting leaves and another for digging and separating soil from the bulbs. in other words we can say that it is a combination of two machines for cutting leaves of onion and digging them without damage. initially for testing purpose, he developed motorcycle rear mounted leaf cutting device as well onion digging device. this motorcycle operated digging device successfully dug onions along with soil and dropped on to the field. after the successful operation he implemented this process into tractor by providing tractor front mounted digging unit with conveying and collection unit. it digs the onion bulbs without damage and collects it in the collector box mounted at the rear of the tractor, which needs to be emptied periodically. the machine can dug around 0.1 - 0.12 hac of land per hour.

title: Bullet shanti ( multipurpose motorcycle operated farming equipment)

details.full_description: for farming operations, tractor is not an affordable option for farmers having small land holding. increase in the cost of fodder for bullock, regular occurrence of drought and shortage of farm labor forced the farmers of saurashtra area of gujarat to look for an alternative to bullock. inspired by local mode of transport, the three-wheel taxi chakdo, innovator has developed an innovative multipurpose farming machine which can do all operations which can be carried out by a pair of bullock. using the self fabricated chassis, drive and power of an enfield bullet motorcycle in front the innovator has retrofitted an attachment with two wheels at the rear with a tool bar to fit various farm implements. the rear wheel of the motorcycle has been removed and an innovative assembly unit has been attached. it can also be designed and attached to locally available chakdo rickshaw or assembled vehicle having minimum 6.5 hp engine. this meets various needs such as ploughing, weeding and sowing seeds and spraying. it can improve productivity and reduce operating costs for farmers, who currently use bullock-driven plough and cannot afford for tractors or power tillers.

title: Hand Pump with Air Filling Device

details.full_description: profile innovator  mr. dahyabhai dharmabhai chaudhari  hails from gandhinagar district of gujarat.gujarat. purpose dayabhai lives in a village and frequently faces the problem of power cut offs. he was facing the problems in lifting water from the underground tank to overhead tank. the frequent problem and his innovative mind motivated him to develop a machine which can manually lift efficiently without any use of electricity. technical details it is a manual/hand operated multipurpose device which can be used to fill the air in tires and also used to lift water. a set of pulleys are provided to increase the rpm of the pump. it is a portable device along with the wheel so as to move easily to the required destination. air can be filled within 2 minutes with this device for one tire of bicycle and it can also lift water up to 10ft. benefits it an easy to use and affordable device and can be used without electricity. suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). portable high pressure foot air pump compressor for car and bike. retrieved on june 28, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/b2c-enterprise-portable-compressor-motorbike/dp/b093tgqs18/ref=sr_1_2_sspa?dch... = indiamart, (2021). deodap high pressure steel air pump for bicycle. retrieved on june 28, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/deodap-high-pressure-steel-air-pump-for-bicycle-19333640462.htm...

title: Groundnut harvesting machine

details.full_description: the innovator is from the family of farmers. he has seen the difficulties faced by the farmers in getting labour and the losses incurred due to inefficient digging. he purchased a groundnut digger in 1988 ( manufactured in elanabad, punjab) and later another digger manufactured in ladnu. he faced difficulties of frequent wear and tear and maneuverability of tractor specially at corners. he also repaired machines used by other farmers and heard the same issues of wear and tear. in order to solve these problems and difficulties he modified the groundnut digger. the innovator has added a vibration pad/shock absorber spring and two pivoted heels in the rear of groundnut digger. it is claimed to reduce load on the tractor three point linkages and increase maneuverability due to wheels, and reduction in breakages ( mainly bearing) due to vibration pad. width of the machine is 5 ft., depth of operation  6-7 inches (which is 1-2 inch below the depth of groundnut). it can cover 12 bheegha/day of 12 h consuming 2 lit diesel /bheegha.

title: Seed drill

details.full_description: profile: about six years ago, suthar brothers developed a disc plough and disc harrow based seed drills. technical details: they claim that the performance of their machines is better than cultivator based seed drills. they prefer to use disc plough based seed drill with gram and mix cropping. while using cultivator based seed drill ( shovel type furrow opener), seeds get stuck or are placed incorrectly due to the presence of weeds. this led the innovators to think and they came up with a novel device seed cum fertilizer drill which has a single disc of harrow. the innovators have made a seed drill/seed cum fertilizer drill using a single gang of disc harrow as the furrow opener. the present prototype has a vertical disc type seed metering mechanism, though innovators are trying to develop a single metering mechanism for all rows. it has 6ft width and can cover 2 beegha/h ( 0.5 hs/h) at a speed of 8-10km/h. the cost of the seed drill is 40,000.

title: Low cost oil extraction unit for aromatic herbs

details.full_description: at the time of first harvesting ( cutting) of the crop he realized that without extraction plant he had to supply his raw material (grass) to third party. it requires an amount of rs. 4 to 5 lacs to establish such extraction plant which was not affordable for him. by nature, being innovative he decided to prepare such extraction plant on his own. first he prepared sample plan which was costing around  rs.17,000/-. after getting success in extraction in sample plant, he again made plate having one ton capacity costing around rs. 1.2 lac.  through this innovation, he has not only reduced his transportation cost for oil extraction but also inspired a lot of innovative farmers and distinguished visitors of the district.

title: Tractor Mounted Harvester

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. sunil kumar hails from bhojpur district of bihar. he is a farmer by occupation. purpose mr. sunil faced a lack of availability of labour during the harvesting and threshing of grains. aiming to find a solution and to utilize straw for useful applications, he started working on the development of tractor mounted combine harvester in 2010. he has developed tractor mounted combine harvester which he modified two times. the first successful machine was developed in 2013. technical details constructional details : the dimension of the harvester l x w is 5 x 6 ft. it can be mounted by a tractor of minimum 45 hp and can be attached with an extended shaft from pto. the harvester comprises multi-groove pulleys and belts, bearings, chains and sprockets, pickup reel, cutter bar, siding belt with rods, conveyor belt with attached blades, squeezing plates, feeding plates, bevel gear, feeding drum, threshing chamber, blower, sieve tray, vertical conveyor belt with trays, storage box, thin cotton pipe, chaff storage cabin, hydraulic rams and hydraulic lever. working : when engine of the tractor gets started and motion is given to pto shaft, then it transfers to sieve tray, threshing drum, blower, feeder, conveyors, cutter bar and pickup reel etc. first, when pickup reel rotates, it pushes crops down so that the cutter bar can cut it easily which has horizontal to and fro motion over the entire length of pickup reel and pickup reel also takes cutting crops to processing path. it has a narrow processing path on one side where the crops go inside to the threshing chamber and a conveyor belt with attached blade accomplishes this operation. a siding belt with rods which takes cutting crop from other sides to the narrow processing path. thre are some squeezing plates over the siding belt through which cutting crops pass and in this way volume of the crops is reduced. feeding plates and drum help the crop to get inside the threshing chamber. then the crops get threshed with the help of hammer bar with blades. after this, chaff is transferred to the chaff storage cabin with the help of blower through the thin cotton pipe system. straw get separated from grains with the help of sieve tray. then the grains transfer to the grain storage by a vertical conveyor with trays. performance according to the innovator, the harvester can cover 1 acre area in 2 hours. it consumes 6-8 litres fuel to cover 1 acre of land. benefits the harvester is suitable for wheat, rice and mustard. the harvester is cost-effective. it can cut declined crops. shattering losses can be reduced using the machine. the machine requires very less maintenance. only one person is required to operate the machine.

title: Pedal Operated Multi purpose Device

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. ram sajeevan hails from gonda district of
uttar pradesh. purpose mr. ram sajeevan has developed a bicycle based
multipurpose device for lifting water, generating power and other similar
applications. technical details developed machine made of frame of iron, paddle rod, crank shaft,
bearing, gears, connecting rod, chain, balances, shaft, bearing block, centre
pin and nut bolt. all the components are connected together to developed a
machine.  in this device pedalling, pressing of the pedals in
ergonomically comfortable position, reciprocating motion is converted into
rotary motion for pump or turbine. the developed prototype has got demand of
local people and their appreciation. benefits a single bicycle is used for electricity generation as well
as pumping water from underground. suggested reading(s): alibaba, (2020). treadle pump. retrieved on december 31, 2020, from https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/treadle-pump_266623096.html amazon, (2020). gi 12 v 6 w bicycle nickel plated iron dynamo generator. retrieved on january 7, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/gi-bicycle-dynamo-generator-12v/dp/b01ctbilwg/ref=asc_df_b01ctbilwg/?tag=googl... youtube, (2017). pedal powered electricity generator project. retrieved on january 7, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mtwts0hclby youtube, (2017). low cost treadle pump for farmers. retrieved on december 31, 2020, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o2a5qoxetkc

title: One motor - two borewell

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. pandiri pulla reddy  hails from nalgonda of andhra pradesh. he  has been doing  farming for last many years. he has two acre of agri land and is growing paddy twice every year using dam water. purpose due to lack of rainfall in 2009 he did not got water from dam. then motor was placed at 80 ft. depth in the borewell of 6 inch dia. and 110 ft. depth. he found the arrangement good for him as it enabled one acre of his land to be cultivated and grow rice comfortably. however, he could not extend it to the second acre as water collection in the well  was not sufficient to pump out adequately for second acre. paddy being water intense crop, one borewell according to pulla was not sufficient for the requirement of second acre. he thought many ways to provide irrigation to the second acre. he considered digging a borewell but could not fit another motor as the dependent transformer was already overloaded. there was no way a new transformer would be installed for his motor. pulla reddy was in fix. he remembered the childhood experience wherein water from a cemented tank is taken out through a papaya branch which was hollow. one end of the branch was put in the tank and suction was created using mouth at the other end till the water gushed into the mouth. the pipe was put down and water followed till the tank was drained.  he decided to use this principle. technical details he took a courageous step of digging a second borewell 25 feet away from the first one. the borewell had a dia. of 6 inches and a depth of 110 ft. he brought pipe (1.5-inch dia.) and placed it in the second borewell for 70 ft. depth and carried it to the first borewell. it was inserted in the first borewell for 70 ft. depth along with its original pipe carrying the submersible pump and discharge pipe above the ground of 2.5-inch dia. after setting, he started the motor and the water gushed out. water from the second borewell started coming into the first one and water flowed continuously with full discharge. supplemented water from the second borewell and the water available in the first borewell, both together provided sufficient water for irrigating the second acre for paddy.  shri pulla reddy was overwhelmed with joy. suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). kirloskar chotu 0.5hp domestic water motor pump (multicolour). retrieved on july 23, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/kirloskar-chotu-0-5hp-domestic-fittings/dp/b079l6vzrj/ref=asc_df_b079l6vzrj/?t... crompton. borewell submersible. retrieved on july 23, 2021, from https://www.crompton.co.in/product-category/consumer-pumps/agricultural-pumps/borewell-submersible-a...

title: Mini loader

details.full_description: profile innovator is from gujarat, purpose today there is a scarcity of labour found across all sectors.  innovator has innovated a mini loader which can serve agricultural as well as commercial purposes.  it is a tractor operated the machine and can perform the task of filling fertilizers, sand, metals and grains. currently, the available version in the market is costly and not easily affordable for farmers and common people benefits easy to use, affordable

title: Separating maize grain machine

details.full_description: purpose- small farmers who grow maize in 1-10 bigha of land find it difficult to store it. they have to remove seeds manually before they can store it. innovator amal das observed that removing corn seeds manually is laborious and often results in damaged seeds. he came up with an idea of a simple device and developed a pedal-operated machine to de-seed maize. the machine is very simple. it uses a bike frame and the rotating cylinder is attached to the pedal sprocket by horizontal gear. the cylinder has plates attached on the inside, which de-seed the maize stick when rotated. the innovator claims that the machine causes no damage to the seeds.

title: Auger plough

details.full_description: during field operation with tractor mounted  cultivator, he realized that cultivator could not get proper depth and he cannot afford to buy plough. so he thinks much about to get the solution of deep ploughing using cultivator. initially he prepared rough drawing of cultivator using auger type blades in the font of cultivator tines and with the financial support from nif he has developed the prototype of auger plough.  the auger plough (cultivator) consists of a steel frame with three point hitch system, five rotary shaft on which blades are mounted, power transmission system, and chain mechanism. the blades are of auger type made from medium carbon steel or alloy steel that hardened and tempered to a suitable hardness. the pto of the tractor drives the auger blades. rotary motion of pto is transmitted to the shaft carrying blades through chain sprocket mechanism. as per innovator's claim a good seed bed and pulverization of the soil is being achieved in a single pass of the cultivator. this device works smoothly and requires low hp tractor as compared to existing cultivators. it covers 1 acre of land per hour with a fuel consumption 2 lit/h.  the depth and width of operation is upto 8 inch & 5 feet simultaneously.

title: Manual grains separating Machine

details.full_description: profile innovator arup giri is a resident of the midnapur district of west bengal. purpose to develop a machine that could separate grains from its crops. technical details one person can pull this machine easily on the paddy straw by its handle. after threshing the paddy, some husk remains in the straw. these remaining husks can be freed from paddy straw by its ( machine) wooden pill which is attached to a wooden barrel. benefits it is beneficial for pulse crops for separating the grains from its plants. suggested reading(s): amita engineering works. manual paddy thresher machine. retrieved on june 10, 2021, from http://www.amitaengineeringworks.com/manual-paddy-thresher-machine-2574727.html youtube, (2011). rice harvest - paddle-driven threshing machine. retrieved on june 10, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cbo82h4oooc

title: Cowdung mulching plates

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. gopalbhai surtia  hails from ahmedabad of gujarat.. purpose gopal bhai after having made fully biodegradable nursery pots from cowdung, he has focused now on the problem of weeds growing in his cotton farm. removal of weeds is manual and labour intensive and has to be done throughout the cotton-growing season. however, the problem is most severe immediately after sowing and in the rainy season. though mulching is not popular among indian farmers. those who are aware of its benefits use plastic films to cover the ground. plastic as such is harmful to the environment and it has to be manually removed from the field after season. if the removal is not done properly then the plastic film can tear apart, leaving the plastic in the field. gopalbhai thought of using dried cowdung instead of plastic for mulching. technical details this innovation is a circular disk made of cowdung and newspaper with a hole for the plant to grow at the centre.  the idea is to place such plates centred at the seeds during sowing time. over days and weeks, the plate will slowly disintegrate due to monsoon rains. since the plate is made of cowdung and newspapers, it will be fully biodegradable. according to innovator, the disintegration of plates will take several weeks. during this time, the plate will prevent sunlight to reach the soil underneath preventing weeds to grow. once disintegrated, cowdung will help plants to grow due to its natural fertilizing properties. benefits composition of the mixture makes it strong and does not attack pests to grow. it is fully biodegradable, it uses newspapers that helps in slowing down the disintegration. it is cost-effective and raw material are easily available. suggested reading(s): indiamart, (2021). cow dung dewatering machine. retrieved on august 11, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/cow-dung-dewatering-machine-16405899812.html yeshunxin. cow dung processing machine. retrieved on august 11, 2021, from https://organicfertilizerplants.com/cow-dung-processing-machine/

title: Eco-friendly Refrigerator

details.full_description:
profile innovator shri khimjibhai is a resident of himmatnagar district in gujarat. purpose to develop a low-cost non-electric refrigerator . technical details shri khimjibhai has developed an eco-friendly refrigerator that cools down water, fruits and vegetables without using electricity. the walls of the refrigerator are covered by batiste clothes and water is passed over it. when air comes in contact with wet batiste cloth, it evaporates water and inside a chamber of refrigerator gets cool down. benefits this refrigerator can also be used as a closet in the months of winter. suggested reading(s): national

title: Sieving of chaff

title: Safety step for single pole ladders

details.full_description: profile: innovator belongs to a farming community. people in his area are involved in farming of spices. the innovator is also involved in organic farming, fish farming, rabbit farming, etc clove trees are 25- 40 ft in height. purpose: farmers use single pole ladders with alternate steps on the pole for climbing. grip on such poles is not good. secondly, keeping feet at unequal levels (over alternate left and right rungs) is a cause of discomfort. third, stability of such poles is also very less. thus, a farmer usually bears risk of falling. technical specifications: to overcome above hazards, the innovator designed a pair of step devices for level feet standing and a safety harness for safety against falling. the safety step is just a two half-mirrored flanges based on design. there is a base where the worker can rest his foot while plucking. the hollow semi-circular shafts on both the halves can be assembled and fastened over the pipe, gently, by using bolts and nuts. the fastening provisions are there in the sides of two flanges. the safety steps are made of galvanised iron. the total cost of this device is rs. 250/- and weight is 2-3kg. benefits: light in weight and low in cost. safe to the farmers.

details.full_description: he comes from a farming background and lives in a small village with his family. he has always been fond of science and technology enthusiast. he now does farming on his four acres of land. in 2014, while interacting with dairy farmer he discussed the problem of labours for cleaning the cowdung in dairy barn. during the visit he noticed the problem of handling the cow dung. in 2015 he decided to develop a machine which can pick up the dung and collect it. he got his final prototype ready in 2018 with about 2.5 years of development. it facilitate labour and also helps to maintain the hygiene in surroundings. this is electric motor operated cow dung collecting machine for dairy barn. a 0.5 hp geared motor operated by one person is used to collect the dung from floor. the machine has continuous dung collecting conveyor and steer by operator. the machine has capacity to collect dung of 8 kg/min and coverage area of 3.71 sq.m/min. the cost of battery powered machine is rs. 12,000/- and ac powered machine is rs. 6,000/-.

title: Lac processing machine

details.full_description: the innovator comes from a humble background from the indian state of jharkhand. he is enthusiastic about machines and aspires to be an electrical engineer. he has interest in physics. his sister is a medical student and father works in the electricity board. lac is the hardened resin secreted by the tiny lac insect. lac insects thrive only on certain trees called lac hosts. butea monosperma (palas), zizyphus mauritiana (ber) and schleichera oleosa (kusum) are the major lac hosts used in india. lac cultivation involves five major operations which are pruning, inoculation, used up broodlac (phunki) removal, harvesting and lac scraping. mostly, lac cultivation operations are carried out manually with the aid of locally manufactured traditional tools. manual lac scraping is a very slow and tedious process. in one method, farmers sit on the ground in a group and scrape lac with the traditional tools like a small scraping knife (dauli) and sickle. in another method, farmers remove lac encrustation by beating lac sticks with bamboo stick. one person scrapes 5-10 kg of lac in a day. as scraping is done on the ground, unwanted foreign materials like sand, soil, and wooden twigs find their way into scraped lac, reducing the price to farmers and creating problems during lac processing in industries. in order to increase the output and reduce the drudgery of lac production, a simple power operated roller type lac scraper was designed and developed. the machine scrapes lac under the action of shear and compressive forces. lac is very expensive and used by many industries. sourav has created a machine that peels lac from branches of trees and plants through pressure system. the conventional process for lac extraction is to cut the lac-coated branches of host trees, crush and sieve the lac to remove impurities. the machine made by sourav can remove lac from the branches without breaking them. as a result, the amount of impurities is lesser in the extracted lac and it takes lesser effort to clean it. the machine is attached with a rotator and works on the principle of a sugar cane juice extracting machine.

title: Innovative rolling table

details.full_description: profile: mr. suren barua is a serial innovator and a fabricator. he owns a fabrication house named tea engineering works situated in panitola village in tinsukia district of assam. he has developed innovations like bsd dryer, tea rolling table, tea steamer, sheetol bisona, domestic room heater and many more. his academic qualification is matriculation. purpose: seeing the less availability of types of machinery in tea industries of assam and the higher price of the available ones, he has been constantly engaging himself in developing tea processing types of machinery at an affordable cost for small tea growers/producers. in addition to this, he is engaged in developing various innovations useful for domestic uses at an affordable cost. existing machines are run by a high rating induction motors which require 3-phase electricity connections. in existing machines, tea leaves get broken during the rolling process compromising the quality of the tea leaves. the structure of the existing machines are based on a 3 legged structure; hence the base has to be fixed with the ground using foundation bolts. so, the machine can’t be moved if needed. existing machines create lots of vibration and noise. there remains a chance of tea leaves getting deposited on the delivery tray without proper rolling. the weight of the existing machines is very high as these are manufactured by the molding process. to overcome the shortfall of existing machines, an innovator designed a new one. technical details: an innovative rolling table is a machine where green tea leaves are rolled to make orthodox green tea, orthodox black tea, oolong tea, etc. the rolling process is used to break the tea leaves into small pieces. it is the intermediate process in making orthodox green tea, orthodox black tea, oolong tea, etc. before this process, the plucked tea leaves are steamed in a steamer and then brought to the rolling table to break the leaves into pieces. after the rolling process, the tea leaves are dried in a dryer. the machine comprises three basic components namely mainframe, rolling assembly and power, and transmission system. the overall dimension of the machine is 4 ft x 4 ft x 8 ft when the lead screw is in full engaged position and 4 ft x 4 ft x 6 ft when the lead screw is not engaged. suggested reading(s): alibaba, (2021). tea leaf rolled,tea rolling machine of small tea processing machine. retrieved on 30 july 2021 from https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/tea-leaf-rolled-tea-rolling-machine_60434231463.html youtube, (2018). tea rolling machine green tea black tea leaf roller machine tea leaves kneading machine dl-6crt-35.  retrieved on 30 july 2021 from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6zufna0uhg

title: Lungi weaving machine

details.full_description: he is a traditional weaver having 34 years of experience in this profession.  after his schooling he use to assist his father in weaving and allied works. from there he learned the art of weaving. mr. sekhar studied up to 7th standard. he is a traditional handloom weaver. after that he shifted to power loom weaving. kannipoduthal is one of manual process and it consumes a lot of time and is labour intensive. in order to relieve the drudgery he developed a machine to do it mechanically. this has worked very well. now 100 families have adopted this innovation in 6 villages.  sizing is being done before waving the threads in the handloom. this process is being done manually. at present this is possible after every 19 metre length. innovatar designed a machine so that it can work for every 200 metres. this machine is also known as pavu, in tamil. he has supplied one machine to a ‘sangu’ brand lungi manufacturing company. in this machine a bunch of warp with 100 ends taken from 100 cones/bobbins is wound on an octagonal frame to form into a round shape (like a wrap creel). while winding on the frame, the gear wheel arrangements are made in such a way to get a cross winding like the shape of 8 (thus easy to unwind after tie-die) after completing 400 meters of warping the machine stops automatically.  there is a mechanical counter/sensor arrangement for this purpose.  then the frame is collapsed and the cross wound bunch of warp (length 3 meters) is taken out and this bunch warp is ready for tie-dye.  after tie-dye the bunch warp is included in the main warp preparation.  thus lungi with tie-dye effect stripes are obtained.  this is meant only for power loom industry at present. this is the replica of hand operated conventional warping mill where the diameter is about 12 feet.  this is manually rotated forward and back ward (clockwise and anti clockwise). after every rotation, lease is formed manually by moving the lease frame to enable for hand sizing of the lungi warp.  340 rotations are to be made alternately to prepare a warp suitable for 8 lungis. the process has been mechanized in the new machine. the major difference between conventional and mechanized machine is in the diameter of the mill.  the size of the mechanized mill drum diameter is exactly 50% of the conventional mill.  thus two rotations are made alternately clockwise and anticlockwise in the mechanized machine to obtain the length similar to conventional one before forming lease.

title: Innovative tea steamer

details.full_description: profile: mr. suren barua is a serial innovator and a fabricator. he owns a fabrication house named tea engineering works situated in panitola village in tinsukia district of assam. he has developed innovations like bsd dryer, tea rolling table, tea steamer, sheetol bisona, domestic room heater and many more. his academic qualification is matriculation. purpose: seeing the less availability of machinery in tea industries of assam and the higher price of the available ones, he has been constantly engaging himself in developing tea processing machinery at an affordable cost for small tea growers/producers. in addition to this, he is engaged in developing various innovations useful for domestic uses at an affordable cost. technical details: the tea steamer is purely unique and a replacement to the roaster machine. in roaster, quality of green tea leaves gets damaged as there is no exposure of tea leaves to water vapors in the roasting machine. tea leaves receive heat injury in roaster and most of the time tea leaves are overheated in roaster deteriorating the quality. time requirement is more in the roasting machine. existing roasting machines are run by 5 hp induction motors which require 3-phase electricity connections.  the tea steamer is used for steaming green fresh leaves employed for two categories of quantity based tea leaves. in the first category as many as 8-12 kg/trip can be processed while in another category the quantity rose 20-24 kg/trip. the capacity of boiling water is estimated at 60 liters in 15 minutes’ duration. the vapor generated from the boiling shall equally applied in all the given surface of the processed leaves. on boiling the poured water the fermentation of the material stop completely and hence the desired quality is being maintained. the significance of the steamer is that it generates the maximum vapor for steaming the targeted material than elsewhere. the steaming of the material takes 1.45 - title: Manual hand lever-based Tapioca plant uprooter /digger

details.full_description: vanchinathan is a school student and winner of apj abul kalam azad ignite awards- 2016. he wishes that india becomes a superpower without corruption, poverty or disasters. he loves making small mechanical gadgets to address local needs. the roots of tapioca plants are usually very deep and they gradually convert into tapioca. plucking out tapioca requires  huge amount of force and a small area of 1000 square meters requires two people per day to attend the task. realizing the difficulties behind the operation, he idealized and designed an instrument with the help of hand lever method.  this is a manual tapoica uproooter. it works on a hand lever based operation. it makes use of two levers which move about a lever shaft which is also the same shaft for driven wheels. one lever has a jaw to clamp around the tree and the second lever helps in digging of the soil. the two levers are pushed together. the simultaneous application of pulling and pushing force helps in easy uprooting of the plant. using this device harvesting of tapoica from over an area of 1000 square meters can be done by a single person in a single day which otherwise requires two persons.

title: Device to Make Holes in Pipe of Borewell

details.full_description: profile he has a joint family and being the eldest son he started supporting his father financially at a very early age. in 2004, he has started a nursery of vegetable crops for supplying it to the farmer. purpose in some areas, the water is available at the depth of 80 feet to 120 feet, hence generally, the bore well is bored up to the depth of 120 feet to 240 feet, based on water availability. the bore well exists up to a certain period, later these wells become dried up. the casing pipe of the bore prevents the lateral water secretion into the bore. by making side holes to the inner fitted casing pipe, the bore can be recharged. but to make side holes to the inner fitted casing pipe, the user may want to remove all the pipes outside from the bore, and after making the holes on the pipe, they are reinserted into the bore. this process is laborious as well as time and money consuming. hence, to avoid this problem, some of the users have tried to fix holed p. v. c. pipes first time/at the beginning itself. this process also failed due to the below reasons. • during the drilling process, due to holes, the pipe strength was decreased, hence, there will be every chance of breaking of p.v.c. pipes. • by holed pipes, the drilling speed was decreased; hence, it is not economically feasible to the bore machine owner. hence, it insists on bore without holed pipes. by observing all these problems, the innovator has thought, for the process, in which one can make a hole to the p.v.c. pipes in its intact position. without removing p.v.c. pipes on casing pipes from the bore. this is time and money conning to the farmer, and he can recharge his dried bore with less expense. technical details in this process, he has designed a drilling machine to make holes to the p.v.c. / casing pipe, which is fixed into the bore, without removing the pipe from the bore. drilling is the process of producing holes by using a specific type of cutting tool. in the present work, the holes can be drilled on the surface of the casing pipe (or) pvs pipe to develop extra water in the existing borewell without removing the pipes, from the bore. in the present work, the size of the hole is equal to the diameter (size) of the cutting. in this work, the drilling machine was assembled with locally available, manually adjusted materials. suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). krost pvc drill machine with reverse forward rotation and variable speed trigger masonry set and hss drill, 450w. retrieved on august 25, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/toolscentre-reversible-machine-rotation-variable/dp/b07nvbnwwr/ref=sr_1_1?adgr... indiamart, (2021). pvc pipe -single head drill machine for 3m. retrieved on august 25, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/pvc-pipe-single-head-drill-machine-for-3m-17855621397.html

title: Cotton seed planter

details.full_description: profile: innovator mr. biki dharna is from orissa. purpose: mr. biki dharna has given an idea to develop machine which can be used in the planting of cotton seeds. technical details: seed metering device meters the quantity of the seed which is going into the farm. it also maintains the required level of the sand in the tank. mostly metering is necessary to track the amount of seed also determine when the seed tank is again filled.  it gives the length or the distance which can be sowed. thus only required seed falls for every rotation of the wheel. construction: the machine will consist of the major parts are structural frame, battery-powered wheels, seed storage tank., seed sowing disc, seed bucket, seed chamber, plough, etc. this is a small cart in which a chisel plough attached under the cart having some inclination to scoop up the soil during pulling. a seed drop pipe is connected next to the chisel plough. the seeds can be stored inside the box of cart. the seeds drop pipe is made in such a way that the seeds will drop over the plane of chisel plough before it reach to ground and in this way, seeds can be propoerly planted. the inclination of the chisel plough depends on the handle position of the cart. the handle also helps in pulling the cart. (fig. is present) benefits: 1. it will mprove efficiency in planting. 2. it will increase the speed of seed planting. 3. seed planting accuracy. 4. it will be durable and cheap as low-cost materials are used. 5. it will have less maintenance cost. 6. dependency  on labor also decreased. also, it saves time of sowing. 7. uniform placement  of seeds  in a row with  required distance. suggested reading(s): kathiravan, r., & balashanmugam, p. title: Green Toilets

details.full_description:
purpose the student has developed the project green toilets that aim at zero defecation on the railway tracks and will improve the level of cleanliness at railway stations, reduce corrosion of rails and rail fittings and consumption of water in indian trains. technical details the human waste undergoes hydrolysis, fermentation, anaerobic oxidation & releases methane and carbon dioxide.  releasing imo, waste undergoes anaerobic decomposition & produce liquid waste, then it is treated to the chlorination process. after treatment, it goes to a tank. through this process, we can reduce the wastage of water in zdis. the solid-liquid separator separates solid & liquid separately. this solid is then treated with imo to speed up the decomposition process. during the series of reactions, it produces natural fertilizer liquid waste, which contains urine having 96% of water.2%urea is extracted from urine & used as fertilizer to the plants. uric acid is converted into urea which is used as fertilizer to the plants. ammonia gets converted into ammonium salts. after this water is sent to the chlorination chamber, after treatment it is pumped to a tank. we can thus reduce the wastage of water. benefits it is durable and sustainable. it may enhance indoor air quality. suggested reading(s): anand, c. k., & apul, d. s. details.full_description: profile: the student's hobby is reading. his teacher c. venu gopal reddy is his biggest inspiration. purpose: a student observed that drain water causes soil, air and water pollution. so he decided to clean the drain using neutralization, centrifugation, precipitation, and filtration. technical details: acidic nature drain is neutralized by adding an appropriate base and the soap water is neutralized by adding appropriate acid. urinals contain some complexions, these ions are precipitated by adding opposite ions and eliminated by the electrolysis method. this drain can be centrifuged using a centrifuge machine that can be used to separate heavy particles from lighter particles. the centrifuged drain can be filtered by four steps. filtration is done by passing the water through carbon, stones,  sand and foam layers. in this way, a drain can be purified.

title: Scarcity of water and proper irrigation system

details.full_description:
profile minto likes reading chemistry and travelling to different places. purpose minto saw poor farmers struggling for water for irrigation in the northeast and other hilly areas. he thought of developing some sustainable solutions where villagers can conserve water for self-consumption and can also use it for irrigation. the idea of minto is to utilize stream water for pounding cereals and grains such as rice or wheat without the use of electricity just as the "gharat water mills" and to meet the solution for the scarcity of water in remote hilly villages lying nearby the streams. technical details the stream water is made to flow through the g.i pipe (galvanized iron) and is used for pounding rice/ wheat or other cereals through a water mill. the wastewater coming out through the mill will be used for irrigating vegetable farms located at the lower slope. the rest of the water flowing through the "man-made streams" will be stored at a water reservoir or water harvesting structures. the flow of water from higher elevation to lower elevation depends upon the gravitational force. the water can be pumped back to villages located at higher elevations by means of a pump that runs without electricity such as a ram pump. the water is then further utilized for micro-irrigation using small pipes containing drip. suggested reading(s): abdurrahman, m. a., gebru, g. m., &

title: Seedling Planter

details.full_description:
profile innovator  mr. priyanshu ajaykumar bhandari is a student from daman & diu. purpose priyanshu observed difficulty faced in the sowing of seeds and hence decided to develop a mechanism for the same. developed vegetable transplanter found more suitable for vegetable transplanting as compare to the traditional method of manual transplanting technical details this is a simple innovation with a handle, with a lever and an iron vessel. every time the handle with the lever is pressed the seed drops in the soil and hence it becomes really easy for the farmer to sow seeds. construction a low cost manually operated single row vegetable transplanter was developed for transplanting of plug and pot type vegetable seedlings on ridges and
mulch beds. it consisted of jaw assembly, delivery pipe, lever, handle, spacing marker, and frame. principle operating principle of the developed transplanter involves the raising
the transplanter up to one feet height and allow to free fall in the soil, dropping the seedling in the seedling delivery tube, pressing the lever in upward direction which
enable the jaw to open the soil and seedling was placed in the soil by gravity and lifting the transplanter with an open jaw and close the after raising the transplanter by one
feet height. working working principle of the machine is one has to hold the prototype in vertical a position with handle and as the jaw in a closed position to the height of 15-30 cm
and allow to fall or press it to penetrate into soil bed, one seedling has to be
picked up from the tray and put it into the seedling feeding pipe, it will be dropped and
held into the jaw from inside. then, pulling the lever towards the handle to open the
jaw inside the soil and the moment the jaw is opened the seedling resting inside
the jaw will drop by gravity into the pit/hole made by the jaw. lift the transplanter lever
in pressed position (jaw open) and the soil accumulated at the periphery of jaw roll back towards the root zone of seedling thus stabilizing the seedling in the pit/hole
and covering the seedling root zone by soil. benefits this planting device is very easy to use. it is light in weight and portable device. this is affordable it will help to increases the efficiency working can save labor cost and time. suggested

title: Fuel from Pine (Cheed) Tree Leaves

details.full_description: profile riya is a student of gsss, nalti. purpose himachal pradesh forest is rich in pine trees. these pine needles can cause lot of damage to the biodiversity and environment due to its highly inflammable nature. the use of wood, crop residue or cow dung for cooking is widespread in the state. the increasing price of l.p.g and electricity is also a matter of concern. so, to find a way of addressing both the issues a modified chulla was developed by riya which can be used to make the char of pine needle biomass. technical details in this modified chullas, there is an empty box made up of iron surrounding the fuel-burning section of chullas. this empty box is tightly filled with dry pine needles. on one time we can fill about 5 to 6 kg of pine needles. these pine needles can be converted into a char in about 2 hours of cooking. there are very small holes between this box and the burning section of chulla. then with the help of this char, we can make smoke free briquette by adding 10% red soil or starch of rice as a binder. benefit in this way, we can save the forest from fire and also give the rural poor the alternate renewable and very economic energy source.

details.full_description:

title: Waste Plastic Bottles as a Small Scale Industry

details.full_description:
purpose nowadays, the plastic bottle has become essential. plastic bottles are used on a large scale for packing liquid substances. it is not degradable and so creates large pollution in the environment. aryan has given an idea to re-use this used plastic bottle. technical details he made a small scale industry to reuse plastic again. initially, in this system, the bottom of the plastic bottle is cut, and the remaining part, i.e. bottles mouth, is attached to a shaft. the cutter at the bottom of the bottle is fixed so that it may cut the remaining part of the bottle in the expected width of the fibre thread. in the next step, these fibre threads are passed to another bobbin from a small bobbin. here they are rotated by using gear motors. thus fibres of different width are obtained by adjusting the cutter. from these fibres, we can make a daily use thing at a very low cost.  in this machine, there is a separate provision given for straightening these fibres. for this, the bobbin to which fibres are spun is attached to the stand. again it is passed through a sleeve. it gets straightened because of the heating coil on the sleeve. the plastic mouth is also used. benefits the plastic threads are used to make brooms, brushes, badminton rackets, poultry compound for protection, homemade showpieces, and binding. thus we can reuse plastic and reduce pollution. suggested reading(s): dutta, s., nadaf, m. b., & mandal, j. n.

title: Multipurpose Insect and Mosquito Killer

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. soubam bhorot singh is a student who lives in imphal west, manipur. he wants to become a scientist in the future and his hobbies include reading comics and various science magazines. purpose it is common practice to use mosquito and insect repellents at home in the form of liquid, spray, coils, etc., which are hazardous to health as well as harmful for the environment. so this student decided to develop a solar-powered model to attract the insects and mosquitoes. he also decided to use a high voltage dc generator that will help in killing the attracted insects and mosquitoes. the device has potential applications in hospitals, schools, public places, agriculture fields, and railway stations. technical details construction : it consists of a small solar panel, led
light, container, net, wire, and dc battery supply. the led lamp is switched on to turn on the light that attracts mosquitoes and insects. working : it is common practice to use mosquito

title: Field Information Indicator Device

details.full_description:
profile md. zishan belongs to meghalaya. technical details the indicator device gives information on the field to the farmers using simple colour coded pipes. the device has four measure pipes that come in brown, silver, blue and green colors. the brown pipe gives information on the fertility of the soil, silver indicates insecticide level, blue gives information on the water level and green gives information about the probability of growth of the crop. benefits with this information, farmers can decide on when and where to start the cultivation, optimum level of insecticide to be applied and to irrigate the fields as per the requirement. the device is developed such that it can be powered using electricity, solar panels or battery. zishan understands the difficulty in developing this device but is committed to develop it and also make it cheap and affordable for farmers. suggested reading(s): jiang, j. a., tseng, c. l., lu, f. m., yang,

title: Flying Insect and Worm Killing Device

details.full_description:

title: Domestic Crusher for Pulses Processing

details.full_description:
purpose traditional pulse crushing methods are quite fatiguing and laborious. generally, female members of the family have to complete this task with a piece of traditional stone-made equipment. the process of crushing includes high frictional force and continuous rotation of one stone wheel upon the other. this continuous rotation of stone wheels often leads to cardiac problems. hence the student has come up with a drudgery reducing solution. technical details the innovation is a hi-tech pulses crusher which is a hand-operated machine where a funnel collects all the seeds, it is later crushed by 2 grinding stones and then collected through a pipe at the lower portion of the machine. this grinding machine comprises two milling stones having a higher surface roughness and relatively lightweight and the drive arrangement is done in such a way that a small amount of force will be required for the grinder to rotate. benefits this will make pulse milling easy. suggested reading(s): goyal, r. k., wanjari, o. d., ilyas, s. m.,

profile dimple is a student from the gss school in rajasthan. dimple wishes that her model helps everybody to contribute to the swachh bharat mission. she aspires to become a doctor. purpose dimple’s model incorporates the use of two separate septic tanks. in this concept, the second tank is used after the first one is completely filled. this is done in a way that while the second tank fills up, the contents of the first tank are converted to manure which could then be used in a field for organic farming and the process is repeated thereafter. she intends to incorporate a biogas manufacturing plant in her system and use this concept for community toilets. benefits the cleansing water does not
need to be diverted separately, but can be flushed down the pan, together with
the faeces. this generally results in high social acceptance. suggested reading(s): rao, s. m., arkenadan, l., & mogili, n.
  v. (2018). performance of modified twin pit toilet in mulbagal town,
  karnataka, india. journal of water, sanitation and hygiene for development , 8 (3), 578-584. youtube, (2016). construction of two leach
  pit toilet. retrieved on may 11, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9w0_jh69rcy youtube, (2017). twin pit toilet. retrieved
