title: Arecanut Peeler/dehusker

details.full_description: the product works on the basis of first order lever where the fulcrum is located between the load arecanut and effort. the product is made of stainless steel and dreid arecanut is placed on one end in between 2 blades one fixed and one movable. once the arecanut is placed, manually move the lever which in turn swing the movable blade towards the arecanut to remove the husk. repeating the same process for the other side of the areca nut, the husk can be completely removed. this method is faster and safer than th traditional method of manually removing the husk. suggested reading(s): fasil, t. k., jishnu, k. d., shabeeh, a. p., xavier saji, k. j., & baby, v. y. (2018). remote controlled arecanut plucking machine. international research journal of engineering and technology, 5 (4), 3587-3591. youtube, (2020).  coconut/arecanut harvesting pole. retrieved on  february 02, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vbmpcupoog8 youtube, (2020). arecanut harvester pole. retrieved on february 02, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3t-buaupnzw

title: Coconut Dehusker

details.full_description:
profile the innovator mr. p. kandraj belongs to the temple city madurai where the peoples are mainly involved in business, agriculture. coconut de-husking is a tedious process in and around madurai. this made him to make a new coconut dehusker. purpose to remove the coconut husk with less effort by the labour and to increase productivity and to decrease time. technical specification the machine operates with 1.5 hp motor single phase electricity. the motor is attached with a wheel through the belt. the wheel interconnects the gear through chain system in turn convicted to 8 knives attached in 4 moving hooks. motor runs with 14000 rpm. the weight of the entire machine is 40 kg. performance when coconut shell is inserted in between 4 hooks, coconut fully removes of husk. he has claimed that person or women can easily peel off 90 nuts per minute. benefits the operator needs to put less effort. per day productivity is very high when comparing with manual operation. less time consuming process and the drudgery also reduces. suggested reading(s): turkson, s. o. adzimah, s. k. title: Engine Operated Paddy Thresher

details.full_description:
profile mr. madhab is a farmer and has more than 40 years of experience in agriculture. purpose earlier
it was difficult in threshing of paddy. later people started using paddy

corrode after using some years. then, one had to take the machine to a
fabrication shop for changing that wire tooth with another with the help of
welding. so he decided to modify this machine so that the wire tooth can be easily changed at home. technical details this is a 2 hp diesel engine operated wooden drum paddy thresher where the drum is made up of wooden pieces having two iron

title: A New Seedless Lemon Variety

details.full_description:
mr. rajabhai ghusabhai harkhani from gujarat has developed a new seedless variety of lemon. crop: lemon ( citrus × limon (l.) osbeck) salient
features: seedless, no thorns, average lemon weight (70 to 80 g), large fruit size, high yielding (40 to 50 kg/tree- 6 to 8 years old), starts fruiting after 2 years. genesis: mr. harkhani started lemon cultivation in 1985. he brought few good lemon fruits from the market to develop seedlings from it. one of the seedlings he found different from the others as it had broad leaves and had no thorns. after 5 years, the plant bore fruits. the fruits were bigger in size with rough skin and grew in bunches. each bunch had 8-10 fruits. later he found out that the fruits were seedless. thus he multiplied the plants through grafting and developed about 100 plants. harvesting season: late winter to early summer

title: New hyacinth bean variety (JK-1)

details.full_description: repeated entry, genesis: the jk-1 hyacinth bean variety is developed by mr. jitabhai through selection method during the drought year (1987). he taken fodder from village- gabhoi near vetla and separated some plants of hyacinth bean mix with it and pods kept for next year sowing. in 1988, he sown seeds from those pods and at maturity times, he found that some plants bears good number of pods and noticed more yield per plant as compared to other plants of hyacinth bean. he collected pods from that good plants and kept aside for sowing in next year. in 1989, he again has sown seeds from that collected pods. in this way, he multiplied seeds in initial phase up to the year 1994 (5 years period). the variety becomes popular among farmers community in the year 2000. since 2000, jk-1 variety sown by many farmers.                                                                       salient characteristics:                                                        the variety are early maturity (60 to 65 days), more number of pods per bunch (25 to 30 pods),   high green pod yield (143.7 t/ha) and high seed yield (64.6 t/ha).

title: Pappachan's method of pepper cultivation

details.full_description:
shri k j baby from idukki, kerala adopted a method of pepper cultivation. targeted
crop: piper nigrum l. (black pepper) ingredients: gliricidia sepium (jacq.) steud., mucuna bracteata dc. ex kurz methodology/practice
detail: 1. surface planting is done which keeps the collar 8" above groudn level. this exposes the collar to weather elements hardens the tissue making the region resistant to easy fungal attack. 2. the support used is jack with 25 % mixing of gliricidia. 3. the root system is allowed to develop away from the base of vine in the interspace. 4. wider spacing of 4 to 6 m is followed. 5. a cover crop of mucuna is used to prevents runoff and soil erosion. 6. jack provides good shade in summer and no shade in the rainy season. (june to september ) due to pruning. 7. only organic manure used during establishment. mucuna debris provides nutrients after 3 years.

title: Green Electricity

details.full_description:
purpose in paddy plants after photosynthesis, there is a lot of glucose deposit in roots. in paddy fields, there are a lot of bacteria’s like aeromonas hydrophila, clostridium bacterium. these bacteria consume the glucose in roots and electrons and protons are formed there as waste products. technical details these electrons are taken using two electrodes. there are two electrodes. one electrode is taken as an anode and the other as a cathode. the bacteria’s here are electrochemically active redox agents. they have electron acceptors in their bodies like cytochromes. the most important advantage of this is the electrodes don’t undergo any redox reaction, so the electrodes need not be changed in intervals. we get 1.5 v from a single paddy plant. in one cent area, there are approximately 500 paddy plants. benefits we can produce a very large potential. it can be used as dc or ac. if we connect it in parallel in a large plot we can produce good ampere. another advantage is it is pollution-free, the bye product of complete reaction is water also we get continues current as long as the plant is in the soil. we get output day and night, summer and winter. it can be effectively done in any plants having glucose. if we use biological fertilizers we get more current, thus the use of bio-fertilizers can be encouraged and the extensive use of chemical fertilizers can be reduced. suggested
reading(s): kaku, n., yonezawa, n.,
kodama, y., & watanabe, k. (2008). plant/microbe cooperation for

recent advances and perspectives in rhizosphere microbial fuel cells. applied microbiology and biotechnology , 98 (23), 9521-9526. lu, y., liu, l., wu, s.,

soil for powering an electronic timer and an analysis of active exoelectrogenic
bacteria. amb express , 9 (1), 1-7. shafie, s. m., mahlia, t. m.
i., masjuki, h. h., & rismanchi, b. (2012). life cycle assessment (lca) of
electricity generation from rice husk in malaysia. energy procedia , 14 , 499-504.

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. k veda varshini is a student from telangana. purpose incidents of flash floods and overflowing roads inspired a student to develop “smart water absorbing road”. technical details: these roads have two layers. the concrete has an upper permeable layer, which is made up of large pebbles so that water can drain almost instantly. the bottom layer is the attenuation layer, which pushes water into a drainage system that connects with the city’s groundwater reservoirs. this water is directed straight into the system for irrigation. benefits this project will also help in saving government funds on an on-road replacement. it will also help in recharging groundwater and rainwater can be used for irrigation and other household purposes.

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. sachindra jadhav is a student from kolhapur district of maharastra. purpose mr. sachindra has developed a low cost multi-purpose agricultural implement, which is friendly and quite useful. using this implement, seed sowing also becomes very simple. this is multipurpose an agricultural tool that is applicable for the following functions: 1.for making furrow 2. sowing of seeds like wheat, soybean, etc. 3.  remove weeds between the crop (weeding) 4. sugarcane bud chipping machine attachment. 5. coconut shell removing the attachment. 6. chaff cutting machine 7. for carrying the load (platform) 8. it also has hooks for carrying loaded bags and provisions for keeping water bottles. technical details construction this is multipurpose portable equipment, made up of different attachments like drum seeder, coconut scrapper, weeder, sowing device, chaff cutter, and platform for placing stuff/bottle, sugarcane bud chipper, etc.  it required very little space for placing. 
 

the drum is attached in between two wheels of the bicycle.
a small 3 ridgers are attached to the device to remove the soil and making
furrow spacing for sowing in soil. whenever the machine is started to use by
pulling on one side, the drum starts to rotate and the seeds filled in the drum
falls into the hole of the funnel through the pipes. the iron pipe attached to the rear side helps to cover the seeds with soil. along with this, a weeder has been
used to remove unwanted weeds. 

this tool also used for removing coconut shells,
chipping buds of sugarcane, and cutting the chaff for animals. there is a platform provided on this tool for carrying the load, it also has hooks tor hanging and a slot for keeping water bottle. dimensions length-8 feet width- 4 feet height- 2.5 feet the radius of wheel -1 feet the radius of the drum- 6 inch distance between end holes- 20 inch performance weight of the
machine-  15kg the capacity of the drum-
15 kg benefits 1. this is multipurpose portable equipment, made up of different attachments. 2. it required very little space for placing. 3. it can be used for sowing of any seeds like rice, soya bean, wheat, sugarcane buds also. 4.this device also can be used for fertilizer application. 5. it is totally manually operated device 6. it has no environmental issues, so it is totally pollution-free.

title: New Organic fertilizer -Organic Urea

details.full_description: shri choode gowda is a farmer from karnataka developed a practice for the preparation of organic fertilizer. targeted crop: for all crops ingredients: cattle urine, sand methodology detail: make a tank in the fam , fill  3/4 th of a tank with sand. everyday pours the available cattle urine into the tank. the sand will absorb the urine. after 15-20 days absorption capacity of sand will be reduced and urine gets collected on the top. now urine looks black. then stop pouring urine. after one week take out the sand, dry it and packed into bags. whenever plants/crops show nitrogen deficiency symptoms (yellowing), use this organic urea instead of chemical urea.

title: Portable Walnut Skin Peeling Machine

details.full_description:
profile innovator mohd shafi ahanger hails from anantnag district of jammu & kashmir. he lives with his parents in a rural village kapran of anantnag
district. he is a physically challenged person. being a son of a blacksmith whose
monthly income is a mere five to eight thousand rupees per month. he wanted
to help his family and with his innovative bent of mind started repairing
mobile phones on his own and thought of establishing a small mobile repairing
shop. it was a better way to help his family members. he has been repairing
cell phones for last many years. without having obtained any technical training, he is able to repair, refurnish or
clean any brand of cell phones. he has been showing interest since his childhood.
and has made many innovative devices like an inverter power supply, a lantern
that works on dc power, a generator using six-volt motor. dealing with the repairing
of cell phones he faced difficulties in repairing pcb and finally was has successful
to make an easy to use the device for repairing pcb and for that has been awarded
by nif in last award function. with his continued innovative thinking on real
problems, he has currently developed a novel device for peeling walnuts. purpose kashmir
is rich in producing walnut of standard quality. peeling walnut’s hulls
immediately after harvest and drying processing are very important steps in
walnut processing. this process of peeling is unfortunately performed still
through manual methods mostly by hands. peeling green walnuts manually is a
tedious, time-consuming and backbreaking process, and adversely affects the
skin of the hands of the person who peels the walnut. to make the process efficient
in terms of walnut peeling rate, cost-effectiveness, hygienic and with reduced
time and labour, the innovator came up with a novel solution by developing a walnut
peeling machine . innovator first designed a manual walnut peeling device
and then later modified it to the present version of manual as well as powered
system. with limited sources and in the off-season of green
walnuts innovator tried to optimize his machine. he experimented using round
stone pebbles. he covered stone pebbles with clay layer
such as to match the physical properties of walnut and tested the function of his
innovation with it. he succeeded in testing the machine by passing clay layered
stone pebbles through the hulling section, which efficiently dehulled the clay
layer of pebbles. this encouraged him and finally, an improved walnut peeling device was developed by mr. shafi. he has tested himself in the last harvesting season of
walnuts and the machine has shown good results by performing peeling of 40kg
walnuts/5min. technical details this is a machine used for peeling of green walnuts.
the green walnuts are fed into the hopper at a level convenient to workers
standing on the ground, wherefrom they are received on a horizontal conveyor
into four parallel rectangular channels mounted atop with shredder plates. the
shredder plates are supported by perpendicular compression springs such that
every size of walnuts can be accommodated underneath the shredder plates and
sufficient compression force can be applied to the walnuts. as the walnuts travel along the conveyor belt-length
they are subjected to impact and shredding forces which lead to the peeling of
walnuts. construction & working : hopper - made with
gi sheet, has a capacity of 20kg. at a
time the hopper outlet is bifurcated, using section
plates, to provide four running channels of walnuts onto the conveyor belt. the green unpeeled walnuts are manually fed into this hopper. horizontal conveyor - two
parallel chains on sprockets mounted at the ends of two parallel shafts. the section of the belt has been made using wheel spokes fixed on
the parallel chains at a distance that is less than the average walnut size of
peeled walnuts so that the walnuts could be effectively conveyed on it. shredding plates - four
adjacent rectangular ss shredder plates have been mounted
atop on each walnut channel on the horizontal conveyor such that the walnuts can
pass from underneath the plates. the gap between the
conveyor belt and shredder plates have been kept less than the average walnut
size so that effective peeling of walnuts through shredding action can be
achieved. these plates have been loosely fixed atop rectangular
channel frames that are in length equal to the length of the conveyor belt and
in width, equal to the width of the channel. compression springs - mounted
perpendicularly atop the shredder plates (three springs
upon each plate along the length). these springs prevent the uplifting of the loose shredder plates against the force of the walnuts during
hulling operation and simultaneously provide compression force to the shredder
plates so as to cause effective peeling of the walnuts. end section - the conveyor
at its end has been enclosed using a t- section plate. corrugated slots have been provided in the vertical wall of
the plate through which only peeled skin
of walnut can pass. motor - 1hp single
phase motor is used to drive the conveyor through belt & pulley
mechanism. frame - all the machine
parts are mounted on a stand made of angle iron thus
combines the parts as one unit and supports them. mmachine then represents three sections viz feeding section, peeling section and
receiving section. working green walnuts put into the hopper
are bifurcated into four channels upon the conveyor belt. in the peeling
zone the walnuts adjust in the gaps
between the spokes of the conveyor belt (without
sieving out of it). as
the walnut travels in pealing zone along the conveyor length, shredding and
impact action on the walnut between the shredding plate and the conveyor spokes
dislocates the walnut from its place (from
in between the conveyor spokes) causing
it to rotate and further subject it to impact forces created due to high
conveyor velocity and spring compression forces. this leads to efficient
peeling of walnut. when the walnuts
arrive at the end section, it makes high velocity impact on the end section
plate. since the walnut
still rests on the conveyor, they rotate continuously in forward direction and
keeps on striking the plate, and remaining skin (if any) gets peeled-off
completely.  due to the continuous flow of
walnuts coming out of the channels from behind
displaces the walnuts out of their place from the end section and they travel
perpendicularly towards the right where they are collected at the outlet. benefit different in design and unique in comparison,
disclosed invention is an indigenous technology relatively easy to use,
low-cost and affordable and allows for the replacement of worn or damaged
shredder plates or other accessories whenever needed. the machine reduces the drudgery of people and
can also provide post-harvest process-related employment and entrepreneurship
opportunities to people. the machine has been made for walnut but could
also be employed for other fruits such as almonds, nutmeg, with similar physical
properties by certain changes in the design of the device. suggested reading(s): indiamart, (2021). peeling machine. retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/peeling-machine.html youtube, (2015). walnut peeling machine. retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xgb-gqmorn0 youtube, (2016). new easy walnut huller, peeler, cleaner machine. retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2l7c1ne5u4 youtube, (2017). walnut peeler. retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=utnyl1hf_3e

title: Low Cost Wireless Automated Poly Farming

details.full_description: profile innovators mr. aditya jaju and mr. rohit gupta both are b.com graduate and wants to invent something new. purpose rajasthan is a dry state with low humidity, high wind velocity poor rainfall, and a warm atmosphere. therefore, farming in rajasthan requires a higher cost. hence there was a requirement to innovate a system to cultivate the crop with minimum water requirement and regulation of agricultural parameters. in this direction, farmers have invented a low-cost wireless automation panel, efficient in regulating crop requirements such as water, fertilizer, climate, to increase crop production. in this way, farmers claimed to save 50% water and 40% fertilizer requirement. technical details the sensor panel for the growth of the crop facilitates better control of the crop requirement. the panel senses moisture in the soil, selects the amount of water accordingly to spread on the soil. different programs are fed to the panel for different crops. for a particular crop, the program automatically decides the amount of water, fertilized, heat, air circulation as per the crop requirement. thus resources are supplied to the plant as per the requirement. the whole panel may be controlled by a specially designed android based mobile application. features: 1. climate control: it senses temperature, humidity, soil moisture in the poly farm, and heat outside the poly farm. then controls the climate inside the poly farms by following facilities - sprinkler- to maintain the sunlight permeable to plants - fogger- to maintain temperature. - curtains- up and down for ventilation - fan- temperature and humidity control. 2. auto irrigation 3. auto addition of fertilizer by - mixing of fertilizer in the water - spreading liquid fertilizer 4. following parameters can be monitored - temperature - humidity - soil moisture heat (outside polyform ) index it includes 9 solenoid valves, 8 air circulation fans, 8 curtain motors, battery backup 35ah, 6 humidity sensors, 6 soil moisture sensors, 6 temperature sensors mixing pumps, wiring for installation, etc. the mentioned setup is enough for a poly farm in 4000 square meters. benefits all the facilities run in auto, semi-automatic, and manual modes. in case of electricity failure, there is a battery backup for dc for 3 days. the panel is easy to install and no expertise is required for operation. almost no maintenance is required. suggested reading(s): parkhe, v.,  sable, r., kajale, g., mhaisdhune, r. & sharmila m. details.full_description:

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. dharam singhhails from the ferozpur district of punjab. he is a grassroot innovator and successful farmer. he has studied up to 5th standard. purpose potato cultivation, especially on large size farms, has got mechanized because; it was not possible to handle the labor-intensive operations like sowing and harvesting. manually harvesting potatoes requires about 800 man-h/ha, which is quite a labor-intensive job. however, the potato-digging operation has been mechanized with the introduction of potato diggers. innovator made this potato digger. technical details the machine is a potato digger shaker and potato digger elevator. the potato digger elevator consists of a shovel, rod chain conveyor, gearbox, and two gauge wheels. the machine digs one or two ridges of potatoes at a time and picks up the soil-potato mass over the rod chain conveyor. the agitating sprocket, of this conveyor, oscillates the rod chain and separates the soil. the tubers with no or very little soil drop out on the ground in a row behind the machine, which is later collected manually. these machines are commercially available and are used widely in the northern states of india. most of these machines are 2-row machines, but 1-row and 2-row both types of diggers are also available. the material required for construction is cast iron, horse power of 21-30 hp, number of wheel are four. the weight of this machine is about 200-400 kg. performance the innovator has claimed that this machine can cover 1.5-3.0 ha/day at a forwarding speed of 2.0-3.0 km/h. potatoes are easily bruised or skinned but are less susceptible when fully mature than when immature. benefits this machine saves a lot of time and effort. suggested reading(s): azizi, p., dehkordi, n. s., & farhadi, r. title: Tapioca Harvester

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. j. r. dhanraj belongs to the central part of tamilnadu where the peoples are mainly involved in tapioca harvesting practice. purpose mr. j.r. dhanraj noticed that harvesting tapioca stems using tractor and tillers was a tedious job especially in sloppy regions where the tractor and tiller cannot be driven. he made a new tapioca harvester to overcome this problem. technical details the device consists of a lever arm, angle plate, sliding shaft, fixed jaw, movable jaw, holders, footrest, links, and fasteners, etc. material required for construction is mild steel –pipe, l angle, square pipe, shafts, lock pin, bolts & nuts, etc. which are locally available. performance the working principle depends on 2nd order principle lever. in tapioca harvester, the pulling force is applied over the lever arm which pulls the movable jaw by means of a connecting link. the jaw just acts as a support for the lever arm and movable jaw. there are two holders, one is to hold tapioca stem and another one is used to hold small stems. there is a shaft that makes the movable jaw to reciprocate when the force is applied from the lever arm. the usefulness of this uprooter is – human stress on tapioca harvesting is minimized. benefits more suitable for local traders who were selling tapioca marketing. it can be utilized for weed removal - of tree plats (young plants) and other purposes. easy to transport from one place to the other. minimum weight 3-5 kg. one-third of force – required compared to manual harvesting force (power). it can be designed & fabricated by local artisans & lathe works. minimum wear and tear. suggested reading(s): babalola, a. a., adetifa, b. o., lawal, n. s., samuel, t., & koya, o. profile innovator mr. ranjan singh hails from indore district of madhya pradesh. he is a farmer and uses innovative ideas to change the economics of agriculture. purpose every year he grows onions on his farm but couldn't get enough margin as the rate of onions is uncertain. also storing onion in cold storage is costly and the traditional method is not so efficient. so he decided to make cold storage himself to store onions. technical details he uses an iron net, bricks exhaust fan, etc to built homemade cold storage. in the hall, bricks are arranged one above the other, then net placed above it. two exhaust fans which arranged in two ways the open barrel is placed at two points in the hall. so this exhaust fan kept the bottom space at the same temperature as above. performance this provides a hygienic environment and cooler air which avoids the damage to the onions. benefit this arrangement increases the lifetime of 6-8 months as compared to the traditional method of onion storage. suggested reading(s): national
research centre for onion and garlic, rajgurunagar (2006). cold storage of onion and garlic. retrieved on march
24, 2021, from https://www.researchgate.net/publication/303749496_cold_storage_of_onion_and_garlic petropoulos, s.
a., ntatsi, g., & ferreira, i. c. f. r. (2017). long-term storage of onion
and the factors that affect its quality: a critical review. food reviews international , 33 (1), 62-83. shah, b., &
khanzode, v. (2017). a comprehensive review of warehouse operational issues. international journal of logistics systems and management , 26 (3), 346-378.

title: Amphibious Jeep

details.full_description:

title: Centrifugal Sprayer

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. upputella krishna hails from the prakasam district of andhra pradesh.  he has studied till intermediate only and has been practicing agriculture since his early twenties. he owns around one and a half acres of dry land. he developed interest overtime to make new agricultural equipment. in order to supplement his meager income, he also has to work as casual labor on other farms. as a child, he was quite serious in studies and inquisitive about most things. he used to bother his father by posing in numerous questions and this father always tried his best to satisfy his son's queries. he was very fond of reading science fiction books. as a result, he became quite imaginative and always kept himself busy in experiments of one sort or another. though he was above average in studies, his parents were against his spending much time on experiments. they feared that he might do badly in studies if he continued like that. his teachers and friends supported and encouraged him a lot though. he  has received some recognition for his work through media and people have also started to acknowledge his efforts. he wishes to experiment with some of his other ideas like saving cooking gas, creating electricity with solar energy, new pedaling methods of cycles, etc., in times to come. purpose it is a manual operated knapsack spinning disc sprayer. while facing problems with battery-operated sprayers, mr. krishna  an agriculturist himself, made the centrifugal sprayer. in this sprayer, the liquid from a tank falls on a fast rotating fan resulting in a misty spray. technical details the spinning disc sprayers are in the market but the innovator has replaced the battery with the gear system. it can spray pesticides in the form of fog. the battery system was replaced by coupling spring-actuated lever and flexible transmission devices for the automation of liquid chemicals. the weight of the sprayer is only 15 kg.  the sprayer consists of a 12 liters hdpe tank with stopper value mounted on an iron stand. a long handle lever is provided with “u” shaped ring and gear wheel arrangements to convert the reciprocating motion into rotary motion. an hdpe knurled disc/fan is connected and powered by a worm gear mechanism. when the operator starts to operate the handle up and down, the reciprocating motion of the lever is transferred and converted as the rotary motion of the fan. the chemicals will flow from the tank to the top portion of the fan with the help of the stopper valve and the fan will break the droplets into the mist form due to its centrifugal force. benefits since the battery was replaced with a gear mechanism to rotate the fan, the cost input for power is nil. this machine will be useful for applications of agricultural chemicals for smaller height plants. suggested

title: sugarcane Juice Vending Machine

details.full_description: profile: innovator mr. har kumar goswami is from the guwahati district of assam. purpose mr. kumar is creative since his childhood and tried to preserve old classical things that are died in current sophisticated technology. he has a printing and advertising firm and he is also interested in social work and politics. technical details he specially designed a vending machine where after insertion of the token, it delivers a glass of fresh and cool sugar cane juice. sugar cane juice is extracted and treated for preservation, then this juice is transferred to the mobile refilling drum. from there on wards juice is transferred to the vending machine reservoir. after insertion of the token, the machine activates and the machine token insertion window closed. then the machine delivers the juice. then the machine automatically ready for the next serves by picking glass from the tray. for this he uses a single-phase power supply; along with one dc pumping motor and the other two low-speed motors are used as a required function. five electromagnets are used, four of these are used for added concentrate and one is used for closing the token insertion window. a micro controller is used to monitor and control the operation of the system. so the above machine is the best example of automation. benefits: it can be helpful to provide various juices at the same time. suggested reading(s): adewole, k. a., adamolekun, m. t., & akinnusi, r. title: Arecanut Husking Tool

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. yesudas is from the kozhikode distrit of kerela. purpose usually, poor farmers use a knife for dehusking areca nuts, which involves the risk of accidents and is time-consuming. observing this problem, mr. yesudas thought of developing an affordable alternative. technical details the developed prototype has two v-shaped pointed blades. on pressing the handle, the blades remove the husk from the areca nut. when the handle is released, the blades come back to their original position due to the spring. only one nut can be husked at a time.the weight of this unit is around 180 kg. performance the innovator has claimed that this device can husk 7.5 kg nuts (200 -220 nuts) per hour. benefit the areca nuts can be husked even while holding the machine in hands. the developed tool is handy and can be operated easily. it is simple to operate with no expertise or high muscle power needed. suggested reading(s): alfaz, abhishek, g. g. a., anand, b. s., anvesh. k., & harish, k. title: Harnessing Energy from Decomposition of Bio-wastes

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. arun kumar kamboj hails from the udham singh nagar district of uttrakhand. purpose mr kamboj attended a training program on organic farming and learned there how to make biodynamic compost.  organic waste is placed in the form of the heap for converting into compost (bio-dynamic compost). the number of wooden sticks is provided along the length of the heap for maintaining the shape of the heap. mr. kamboj used once gi pipes instead of wooden sticks and observed hot air inside the pipe, which led him to think and develop the bio-geyser. technical details it is a system for getting warm water in winters by utilizing heat evolved in exothermal reactions during the decomposition of biomass (organic wastes). pipeline containing water is passed across a heap of the organic wastes. water can be warmed up to 60-70° c after storing for a period of 24 hrs (morning to morning). the amount of water that can be warmed up depends on the size of the heap. the system consists of a heap (15 ft × 4 ft × 4 ft)  of organic wastes and valves to allow water in or out from the system. the mentioned size of the system can be useful for a family of five people (75 lit water can be prepared for taking bath). one needs to change the biomass after 25 days. the fertility of the compost doesn’t alter due to extracting heat if the quantity of water to be warmed up is kept under the allowable limit. benefit organic waste is available in the market. this bio geyser is heap and efficient. suggested reading(s): biogasworld, (2020). turning food waste into energy to power homes. retrived on 29 april, 2021, from https://www.biogasworld.com/news/turning-food-waste-into-energy-to-power-homes/ irvine, g., lamont, e. r., & antizar-ladislao, b. (2010). energy from waste: reuse of compost heat as a source of renewable energy. international journal of chemical engineering .

title: Blind Man Stick
keywords: Wand for the blind with sensor

details.full_description:
profile wazeer hayath's native village is thyamagondlu, which is nearby his present place of stay at valmiki nagar at the
outskirts of tumkur (towards bangalore). he used to be a borewell mechanic who shifted to the city from the village so
that his children can be provided good education. in his family, he has his wife balqias unnisa (43, class 7th,
housewife), daughter moinraaz (25, married, has a son), mohd. ashfaque (23, hotel manager, shifted to bangalore
as he does not like his father spending money on innovations), and mohd. aleem (18, he is now working with his
father, dropped out of diploma and is doing a welder course from iti). wazeer sold whatever property he had to
work on his innovation and has been living in rented houses since then. in 1988, mr.wazeer noticed a visually challenged person slip and fall into a slushy pothole while crossing the road. as he was on the other side he could not lend the help immediately. this incident forced him to develop something for helping the blind in the movement without any fear. this innovation will change life for the visually impaired or challenged by alerting them if they are on the water on coming across a pit through a voice recorder system. as soon as the sensor touches the moist medium, it collects the signal through a collector and gives the command to an audio speaker. it will start alerting like water/mud careful if there is a movement of public the person can press the toggle switch and a voice alert will be given to the public with “excuse me side please”. for hearing impaired people, a vibration system can be provided with the same system. the innovator has developed three variants. technical information and specifications the walking stick consists of a circuit
board, speaker, charging socket, on/off switches, push-button, 6
batteries -7.2 v and charger. the moisture sensor is provided at
the bottom-most point of the stick with nylon tip of 2 inches. the tip has +
ve and – ve poles so that unless it senses the 2-inch depth of water of mud it
won’t provide the signal. a pcb voice is recorded to provide an alert to the
person. the toggle switch is provided to alert the nearby people by saying “excuse me side
please”. the total height of stick is about 48 inches and it can be unfolded with stainless steel
spring and a stopper benefits it will help blind people when they are walking outside.

title: Low-Cost Manual Bottle Filling Machine

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. late md. motin ahmed is from the assam state. purpose for his toilet cleaner manufacturing plant, late motin ahmad needed a bottle filling machine. the machines available in the market were very costly and required electricity. as he did not have enough resources to purchase such a machine and that the electricity supply was quite irregular, motin ahmad decided to develop his own machine. technical details his machine runs without electricity and is much cheaper in cost than those commonly available in the market. this is a bottling device. the liquid to be put in the bottle is kept in the head tank. on the lower side of the head tank, nine pipes are there. from these pipes, the liquid falls into the measuring jar. the size of the measuring jar varies with the quantity of liquid to be filled. from the jar, the liquid falls in the bottles kept on the conveyer belt. as a batch of bottles fills up, the conveyer belt moves to put another batch in a proper position. benefit it is easily available and less costly. suggested

title: Cardamom Polishing Machine

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. n. j. thomas is from the idukki distrit of kerela. purpose processing of cardamom (drying, polishing, washing, grading, etc) is a tedious and tiresome job for the innovator, who was growing cardamom. dust is generated in the polishing process. polishing is the process of removing the flower stalk and other dirt and impurities from hot dried cardamom. polishing involves a lot of hard work and injuries to the hand are common. getting laborers for this job is the other problem. these issues triggered the innovator, to think of a solution. technical specifications: the cardamom polishing machine (carpol) developed by shri thomas consists of a rotating drum (grading sieve net lining inside), a central rotating shaft with wooden leaves, a lever for manual operation, and a belt & pulley for transmitting power from a 0.5 hp motor.  hot dried cardamom is put into the drum through the window for feeding, water is supplied and the drum is rotated. the polished cardamom can be collected by opening the window in the drum whereas the waste and other dust at the separate outlets below. performance it can polish 2 kg cardamom per minute which otherwise takes about 6 minutes. benefits it saves time for the operation and reduces the number of labour required. suggested reading(s): aayush engineering works (n.d.). cardamom polishing machine. retrieved on march 16, 2021, https://www.aayushengineeringworks.com/cardamom-polishing-machine.html indiamart, (2021). cardamom polishing machine. retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/cardamom-polishing-machine-11680735473.html james. t. j. (2021). a farmer innovation spreads far and wide. leisa india, retrieved on march 16, 2021, from https://leisaindia.org/a-farmer-innovation-spreads-far-and-wide/

title: Five wheeled car

details.full_description: technical details: the car comprises of five wheels, out of the four wheels (similar to that of the conventional car) are dragged/freewheels, while the central wheel is the drive wheel. the engine with a gearbox (the engine of a moped in the present model) is directly coupled to the fifth wheel. it eliminates the use of differential and driving axles, which has reduced the cost as well as power losses. for serving the function of differential (dividing equal power with different speed/torque), while the car is in mud; a simple screw jack system is planned to be developed. the steering system provides is simple mechanical steering and at low speed (maximum 40 km/h) it is the cheapest option. to date, the product is in crude form but has a scope of low-cost cars. shri saini brothers are expecting that after using any bikes’ engine, the car will give high mileage 45-50 km/l, against 18-20 km/l of the available cars and will cost about 60,000. however, the car will be able to give a maximum speed of about 60 km/h.

title: Shrub Cutting cum Pit-drilling machine

details.full_description: profile innovatro, mr. h.v. lalzuimawia belongs to mizoram. purpose in mizoram, there were plenty of vast lands that are not utilized for common man use, all these lands were covered with bushes and creepers. once innovator visited a village in mizoram and noticed many farmers were working very hard in the sunlight to clear the unwanted plants and grass for cultivating crops. hence, he decided to make a device that makes the work easier and fast. this is a portable device for grass-cutting and drilling pits for the purpose of agriculture and horticulture requirements, for hill areas and rugged terrain in mizoram (jhum cultivation) and in other hilly areas in northeast and elsewhere. technical details the equipment is powered by 1.5 hp two stroke petrol engine which starts in kerosene and runs on petrol, this air-cooled engine has 6000 rpm, has a shoulder strap and a back cushion, it can be carried in the back and weighs only 4 - 5 kg. it has two arms for different purposes of use, one for cutting grass and drilling pits.  the approximate machine weight is 5 kg. benefit easy shrub cutting and pit-drilling. suggested reading(s): amazon, (2021). hectare aluminum telescopic long reach (10 feet) cut and hold pruner with saw. retrieved on 27 april, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/hectare-aluminum-telescopic-reach-pruner/dp/b08sm4bcr1/ref=asc_df_b08sm4bcr1/?... amazon, (2021). balwaan earth auger 63cc with 8" & 12" bit petrol engine hole digger. retrieved on 27 april, 2021, from https://www.amazon.in/balwaan-earth-petrol-engine-digger/dp/b08sjz4v78/ref=asc_df_b08sjz4v78/?tag=go... industrybuying, (2020). ever strong brush cutter complete shaft 28mm. retrieved on 27 april, 2021, from https://www.industrybuying.com/brush-cutter-ever-strong-agr.bru.62860805/?utm_source=google&utm_medi...

title: Fish Dryer

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. devan singh is from the imphal district of manipur. in traditional processes used in manipur, fish was dried under the sun, which was very time-consuming. it required protecting the fish from other animals also so innovators tried to solve the problem by contributing his knowledge. purpose in traditional processes used in manipur, fish was dried under the sun, which was very time-consuming. it required protecting the fish from other animals also. observing the problems, the innovator developed a fish dryer which can uniformly dry the fishes in a very shorter period than the traditional process. technical details this innovation has a closed vessel type structure so that no need to save from other animals. the innovator has developed three different sizes of fish dryer - small size (35.5cm x 24.4cm x 41cm), medium-size and large size (65cm x 40cm x 60cm). the fish dryer uses charcoal and paddy husk as fuel. the medium size model has a provision of the detachable fuel chamber. the charcoal chamber is directly connected and opens to the heating chamber/ drying chamber. it has the perforated plate, bigger than the opening, attached to it so that heat from the charcoal doesn’t enter directly to the heating chamber. the heating chamber/ drying chamber lies above the perforated plate. the lower surface of the chamber is perforated so that heat could easily pass through to the chamber. the top portion of the chamber is covered with a slidable opening. once the top portion is closed then the dryer becomes completely airtight. about 100-150 g of charcoal is enough for one-to-two rounds of fish drying, depending upon the quantity and type of drying for small fish dryers. benefits easy to use, fast process than older one, usable in winter and rainy season suggested reading(s): bala, b. k., & mondol, m. r. a. (2001).

title: Modified Hadamba Thresher for Threshing Castor Crop

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. jagmal singh is a resident of the bhiwani district of haryana state. purpose once, there was a high production of castor in the innovator's region. at that time most of the farmers were using hadamba thresher (multi-crop thresher) for threshing the various crops. the same thresher was used to thresh the castor crop which was resulting breakage of seeds and farmers were not fetching the proper price/value of their crop. this forced the innovator to think and modify the thresher to suit if for threshing castor crop efficiently. technical details he reduced the concave clearance to 1/3rd of the original, eliminated the feeding system by placing a simple inclined tray, and reduced rotor speed to 150 rpm which was in the tune of 500 rpm earlier. performance the innovator has claimed that the threshing capacity of the machine ranges from 15 to 17 quintals per hour and the fuel consumption rate of this machine is about 2 litre per hour. the seed breakage is about 5 per cent. benefit it is also suitable for threshing gram apart from castor. suggested reading(s): dhananchezhiyan, p., parveen, s., & rangasamy, k. title: Car for Physically Challenged

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr.abdul raseed dar is a resident of chowgam village of kulgam district, jammu & kashmir. purpose the innovator wanted to travel to meet his family members but his movements were limited because of physical ailments. public transport was cumbersome and didn’t allow him much flexibility in time. at the same time, he wanted to be free from dependence on others for his movement. he wanted to purchase a car so that he could move around freely without anybody’s help. but the cars in the market were very costly. so, he bought a second-hand car and decided to modify it. the innovator is left limb disabled and modified an old car so that he could drive it. technical details he transferred the clutch control in hands from the foot pedal by spending just one hundred rupees.  he attached a rod to the clutch pedal so that it could be pressed. he also put a small hook to hold the pressed rod (and the clutch) so that he could free his hands and change the gear. once the gear is changed, the rod is unhooked and the clutch is released. benefit by using this innovation, the person with a disability can go anywhere freely, without anyone's help. suggested reading(s): dols,
  j. f., garcia, m., & sotos, j. j. (1996). procedure for improving the
  ergonomic design of driving positions adapted for handicapped people. boletín
  factores humanos , (12-13), 7-17. haslegrave, c. m. (1991). driving for handicapped people. international
  disability studies, 13 (4), 111-120. kwak, j. k., jeon, t. w., park, h. y., kim, s. j., & an, k. d. (2008).
  development of an emg-based car interface using artificial neural networks
  for the physically handicapped. journal of information technology
  services, 7 (2), 149-164.

title: Motorcycle Driven Ambulance

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. late netai dasgupta is from the murshidabad district of west bengal. purpose it mainly consists of a motorcycle, ambulance-trailer, and a connector for towing the ambulance trailer. the two-wheeled ambulance-trailer can accommodate two to three persons inside, provided towing hook, which could be attached to any kind of motorcycle. technical details it has also sprung suspension to provide more comfortable ride patients and passengers. the space available inside the ambulance-trailer (cabin) is 6.5 ft × 4 ft × 4 ft and ground clearance is 1 ft. the mechanism to connect the motorcycle to the ambulance-trailer (cabin) is just the same as used in a tractor. it takes less than two minutes to attach/detach the cabin with the motorcycle. there is a provision of a stand in front of the ambulance-trailer (cabin) so that the ambulance-trailer (cabin) does not fall when a motorcycle is detached. performance the vehicle has no chance of overturning in normal uses. expectations can be there if the condition of the road is very bad and the driver is driving at high speed. benefits the motorcycle can be easily attached and detached from the ambulance, low cost, and easily movable in the rural areas. it can be used for transport and other applications suggested reading(s): unicef, (2020). motor-bike ambulance:

title: Sugarcane Scraper

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. rajeev patel hails from nashik district of maharashtra. he could not clear his 11th standard examination thus he could not persue his further studies. he look after their farmland and has been engaged in the farming profession when he was studying in 9th standard. his sustenance depends on cultivation of agricultural crops. purpose mr. patel extracts the juice of sugarcane and sells it during season he thought that some time sugarcane is infected with some disease, resulting in red spots present in the sugarcane. some people are avoiding drinking juice of sugarcane due to these diseases. he got an idea for making sugarcane scraper because of his business. so he thought that after removing of the rind of sugarcane we can see that whether sugarcane is infected with deceases or not so that people can get the feeling of fresh juice. technical details sugarcane scraper is a hand-operated device to remove the rind of sugarcane so that human can see whether sugarcane is infected with deceases or not and so that he can drink fresh juice of sugarcane. extracting of the juice of sugarcane is after scraping of sugarcane. this device is domestic so that women can use this device to remove the rind of sugarcane. this device is consisting of a u-shape blade and to grip this blade, round shape ring with rubber grip is connected with both ends of the blade. finger and thumb are placed in these rings and then scraping operation is carried out through u- shape blade. benefits it is a very low cost and easy to operate the device. suggested reading(s): adewole, k. a., adamolekun, m. t., & akinnusi, r. title: Black Pepper Plucking tool

details.full_description: purpose: pepper is either plucked using a regular nipper or manually.  a nipper drops the pepper on the ground while manual plucking damages the pepper. a farmer from the innovator’s village approached him to make a machine to address these problems.  this was the trigger for the innovation. technical specifications: the nipper/technology consists of a two feet long pvc pipe attached to a triangular cup (with four inches length and 2.5 inch breadth). there are four teeth on the upper side of the cup. the stalk of the pepper is held by the teeth of the nipper and collected in the cup. benefits: the length of the nipper is adjustable by attaching pvc or gi pipe. the pepper will be trapped in the spikes/teeth of the tool and collected in the cup.  a half kg pepper can be collected in the cup. it makes plucking easy. one pepper bunch can be plucked in a second.

title: Digital Starch Measuring Scale for Cassava (Tapioca)

details.full_description:
profile innovator mr. s. rajamani hails from salem district of tamil nadu. he studied upto 12th standard. purpose the innovator lives in the tapioca belt of south india and sago rice is derived from tapioca (cassava). the price of the tapioca crop is dependent on the starch content and the traditionally manual process of determining the starch content is inaccurate and this causes the farmers to lose money. this provided the motivation for innovation. thus he developed a digital starch measuring scale for cassava. technical specification the device consists of weighing scale, digital pcb board, drum, lever and weighing pan. the dimension of the device is length x width x height = 15" x 12" x 4". the device is an excellent example of a product fusion where the innovator has picked up the manual machine and fitted it with a digital weighing scale. he then goes on to replicate the starch point digitally within the equipment. working the tapioca is put into a bucket and the weight on the pan is balanced and the scale is locked. the tuber is then immersed in water and the lower point scale is adjusted until the balance is reestablished. the reading on the point scale reveals the starch content of the tuber. the innovator has replicated this process on a digital scale with an enhanced design which reduces the number of pans being used. one is also not required to manually shift the tapioca from one pan to another as the lever is used to submerge the tuber in or remove it from water. in this case, the device acts as a conventional digital weighing machine. when the lever is pulled down and the tapioca is submerged, the switch present inside the digital weighing scale switches from the digital weighing scale circuit to the point scale circuit and the analogue signal is represented digitally. benefits it gives excellent accuracy of output. it is easy to use. it increases productivity as no time lost in reading. suggested reading(s): international starch institute, (1999). determination
  of starch in tubers by under water weight. retrieved on march 23, 2021, from http://www.starch.dk/isi/methods/13starch.htm sungzikaw, s. (2008, june 2). measurements
  of starch content in cassava . slideplayer. https://slideplayer.com/slide/4481913/ surtono, a., aprilliana, p., supriyanto, a.,
  pauzi, g. a., & suciyati, s. w. (2019, october). measuring of cassava
  starch content by using strain gauge. in journal of physics: conference series, 1338 (1), 012019.

title: Seed Drill

details.full_description: profile innovator mr. gopal dave hails from the jodhpur district of rajasthan. the innovator worked as an agricultural laborer. while engaged in this work, he felt the need for a machine that could sow multiple seeds, reduce wastage and save labor cost. this eventually led to the development of the seed drill. purpose mr. dave has developed a seed drill to reduce the labour requirement and can sow multiple type seeds in the field. technical details the system consists of mainly a seed tank with an observation window, a seed control adjustment tapered screw of 10 teeth per inch with a top seed distribution cone, and a bottom seed distribution plate having 8 equidistant 26 mm diameter holes housed in an mild steel cylindrical cover and a seed control bush. eight plastic pipes (3/4" size) have also been provided below the distribution plate to collect the seed and convey it to the furrow openers fastened with the shovels of the cultivators with the help of clamps. the power is taken from the ground wheel having 12 lugs fixed at 90 degrees along its periphery through a flexible hose pipe of 4.2 cm diameter and 1.8 m length. the complete unit can be placed on a conventional 9 tyne cultivator and fastened to work as a complete seed drill unit. seed metering mechanism the seed metering mechanism comprises a ground wheel, chain, and sprocket transmission system, a set of bevel gears for transmitting power at a right angle, an inverted conical auger, two different sizes of bush housing the auger and hopper housing the bushes. clearance between auger and bush decides the seed rate, which can be varied by lifting up downing the auger. the seeds passing through the above gap are distributed evenly by the distributor unit to all the feed pipes (eight or nine). performance the innovator has claimed that the seed metering mechanism developed by him is new and different from the conventional method and he has also claimed that it has a uniform distribution of seeds, suitable for mixed crop sowing. benefit it is lower in cost and capable of placing a small quantity of seed available in the seed box, unlike other seed metering mechanisms. it is lower in cost and capable of placing a small quantity of seed available in the seed box, unlike other seed metering mechanism. it can be used for sowing a single kind of seed (general practice) as well as for mixed cropping. suggested reading(s): gautam, a. k., shrivastava, a., samaiya, r. k., & jha, a.
